title: Leverage Agent- Accounting VA
description:
Must Have: 



5 years or more experience doing accounting

Accuracy and attention to detail — catches errors and keeps financial records precise.

Integrity and honesty — handles money and confidential financial information ethically.

Organization — keeps invoices, receipts, reports, and records easy to track.

Reliability — consistently completes tasks and meets deadlines.

Analytical thinking — identifies discrepancies, trends, and unusual transactions.

Accountability — takes ownership of mistakes and corrects them promptly.

Time management — prioritizes effectively, especially during month-end, payroll, tax, and reporting deadlines.

Confidentiality — protects sensitive employee, client, and company information.

Communication skills — explains financial information clearly to non-accounting colleagues.

Problem-solving ability — investigates discrepancies instead of simply reporting that numbers don't match.

Strong follow-through — follows up on missing documents, unpaid invoices, reconciliations, and pending items.

Process-oriented mindset — follows controls and procedures while looking for ways to make workflows more efficient.

Adaptability — learns new accounting software, policies, and reporting requirements quickly.

Teamwork — collaborates well with operations, sales, management, vendors, and other departments.

Professional skepticism — verifies information when something looks unusual rather than automatically accepting it.

Initiative — anticipates problems and addresses them before they become bigger issues.

Consistency — maintains the same high standard even with repetitive accounting tasks.

Business awareness — understands that accounting isn't just about recording numbers; it's about helping the company make better financial decisions.



Experience with tools like: Google workspace, Hubspot, Stripe



To apply: Send your updated resume.

title: Full Stack Developer Manager
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer Manager to lead a team of front-end and back-end engineers while staying hands-on with architecture and code quality. You'll balance people leadership with technical direction, ensuring the team ships reliable, scalable web applications.



Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of full stack developers, conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning

Own technical architecture decisions across front-end (React/Vue/Angular) and back-end (Node.js/Python/Java) systems

Collaborate with Product and Design to translate requirements into technical specs and sprint plans

Review code, enforce best practices, and maintain high standards for testing, security, and performance

Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and sprint planning using Agile/Scru
thodologies

Drive CI/CD pipeline improvements and DevOps practices in partnership with infrastructure teams

Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the stack

Report on team velocity, technical debt, and delivery risk to senior leadership



What You'll Do

You'll serve as the technical and people leader for a team of full stack engineers. Your job isn't to write every line of code or make every architecture decision alone — it's to guide the team, remove obstacles, and make sure the right work gets done well and on time.

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of front-end and back-end engineers

Guide technical architecture decisions and review code for quality, security, and performance

Translate product requirements into clear technical plans with your team

Coordinate with Product, Design, and QA to keep projects moving

Run sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros that actually help the team

Unblock engineers when they're stuck — technically or organizationally

Represent engineering in conversations with leadership about timelines, trade-offs, and risk

Help transform individual contributors into confident, capable engineers



Required Qualifications

6+ years of full stack development experience (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and back-end frameworks)

2+ years in a technical leadership or management role

Strong knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL), RESTful APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD tools, and Agile project management

Excellent communication skills and experience managing cross-functional stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience scaling engineering teams from small to mid-size

Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)



What We Offer

Competitive salary and equity

Health, dental, and vision insurance

Flexible/remote work options

Professional development budget

title: Web Development Manager
description:
As a web development manager, you will oversee all aspects of our web projects, from design to deployment. Your role will be crucial in ensuring the highest performance, security, and user experience standards. The successful candidate will excel in guiding the team, managing resources effectively, and driving the technological direction of our web initiatives.



Key Responsibilities:

-Lead and manage web development projects, from concept to completion.

-Supervise the team with their day-to-day tasks and foster a collaborative environment.

-Oversee the implementation of technical frameworks and best practices.

-Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to keep our web projects cutting-edge.

-Ensure high standards of code quality, security, and performance optimization.

-Develop and enforce testing protocols to ensure reliable, bug-free releases.

-Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to enhance team performance.

-Coordinate with other departments to align web projects with overall business goals.

-Manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables effectively.

-Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues as they arise.



Qualifications And Skills:

-Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field

-Extensive experience in web development, with a strong technical background

-Proven experience as a web development manager or in a similar leadership role.

-Expertise in modern web development frameworks (esp. Elementor) and libraries

-Proficiency in database management and version control systems

-Strong organizational and leadership skills

-Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail

-Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines



Basic Requirements:

-Device Specifications: Intel i5 processor or higher with a minimum of 8GB RAM

-Equipment: Webcam, speakers, and a microphone or headphones

-Internet Speed: Minimum of 100Mbps with a backup connection in case of outages



Work Details:

Location: Anywhere in the Philippines

title: Growth Lead
description:
About the Role:



We run a portfolio of B2B companies serving real estate professionals and SMBs — staffing, services, SaaS, and AI products. They share a buyer and a go-to-market motion, which means one well-built lead engine can serve all of them. That's the job.

You'll own demand generation across the portfolio: architect one repeatable, multi-brand lead machine — cold outbound, paid, and lifecycle running as a single system — and own the number it produces. This is a builder's role, not a campaign-runner's. You report to the CEO and operate autonomously: you set the plan, run it, and report weekly. We're not looking to manage you day-to-day.



This role only works for someone who has run multiple accounts at once. If you've lived in one brand your whole career, this will overwhelm you. If you've juggled a book of B2B clients and liked it, keep reading.



What You Own:



A monthly qualified-lead and pipeline target across all brands. You're accountable to the number.

One shared lead engine — built once in GoHighLevel, templated across brands — not four disconnected efforts.

Full-funnel demand gen: cold
 infrastructure (Instantly + Million Verifier), paid acquisition, landing pages, and funnels.

Brand-specific offers and messaging running on shared infrastructure. Same plumbing, distinct positioning per brand.

Lead-to-customer conversion: nurture, lifecycle automation, and clean handoff to sales.

A flexible contractor bench (PPC, copy, list-building) that you direct and scale as volume demands.

The numbers — CPL, stage conversion, CAC, pipeline contribution — reported weekly in a format the CEO reads in five minutes.



What We're Looking For:



4+ years in B2B demand generation, growth, or performance marketing — with agency or multi-brand experience. You've run 3+ accounts or brands simultaneously and it's second nature.

Full-funnel, not a single-channel specialist. You've built outbound engines and run paid and owned lifecycle. If your track record is only ad accounts and CPC optimization, this isn't your role.

A quantified track record: leads generated, CPL improved, pipeline driven. Bring numbers.

Proven cold-outbound experience at volume — deliverability, list hygiene, sequencing. This is a core channel here, not an afterthought.

A systems-builder by instinct. You build one machine and template it; you don't reinvent per brand.

Thinks in unit economics. If you can't tie a campaign to CAC and payback, pass.

Self-directed. You own the plan and the result without being managed into action.

Stack You'll Work In

GoHighLevel · Instantly · Million Verifier · Google Ads · Semrush · AI tools (Claude / ChatGPT for production speed). Deep fluency in any of these is a strong advantage.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days):



One shared, instrumented lead engine live across the priority brands — CPL and conversion baselined for each.

Cold outbound producing booked, qualified meetings consistently, across more than one brand.

A weekly portfolio pipeline report the CEO can trust at a glance.

One repeatable channel proven and ready to fund harder — and a contractor bench in place to scale it.



Compensation:



Base commensurate with a senior growth operator, plus performance upside tied directly to qualified-lead and pipeline targets. We pay for results and structure it so your incentives match ours.



Schedule:



Full-time, permanent. US Eastern (EST) hours required.



Apply here:

title: REAL ESTATE Lead Manager
description:
LOCATION: REMOTE

COMPANY: HBI HOME SOLUTIONS, LLC

POSITION TYPE: FULL-TIME



SALARY:

Base pay range: $6/hr - $9/hr depending on experience level.

Bonus/commission: 1% of net profit per deal, ranging from $150-$750 per deal depending on net profit. Average total bonus/commission is around $750 per month (average 3 closed deal per month at $25,000 net profit each deal)

Total pay range (base + commission) per month: $1200/mo - $2500/mo



OUR COMPANY:

We’re a real estate wholesaling company with main markets in GA & SC with a focus on acquiring deals from Real Estate Agents. We transact about 80-100 deals a year with gross revenue of $1.8M+/year. You can learn more about us and our model through these two podcast videos on Youtube:







RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Build and nurture relationships with real estate agents to buy properties from them. 

2. Conduct outbound cold calls to local real estate agents to start new relationships. 

3. Follow up with existing real estate agents in company database to check if they have any potential deals we can buy.

4. Conduct discovery calls when real estate agents send us new deals to qualify the deals based on motivation, condition, timeline, and price.

5. Support Acquisition Manager with making offers through real estate agents to buy their listings/properties.

6. Support Acquisition Manager with following up on offers previously made to get the properties under contract.

7. Maintain accurate records of calls, appointments, and lead information in the company CRM.



REQUIREMENTS:

1. Fluent in English with minimal accent, capable of clear and effective communication.

2. Minimum 6-month experience in Real Estate Lead Manager/Sales. Experience in comping/underwriting are preferred.

3. Must be able to work minimum 8-hour shift on US Eastern time zone (8-10 AM EST to 5-7 PM EST).

4. Must be able to call 1-2+ hours talk time and send out 20-35 manual texts a day

5. Familiarity with U.S culture preferred.

6. Ability to work independently and efficiently in a remote environment.

7. Strong interpersonal skills with a confident and persuasive demeanor.

8. Excellent time management and organizational skills.

9. Basic knowledge of GoHighLevel is a plus but not required.



BENEFITS:

1. Competitive salary with the opportunity for performance-based bonuses.

2. High potential for career growth and advancement within the company. Once proven skills, can be promoted to Acquisition Manager to increase income potential.

3. Flexible work hours to accommodate other commitments.

4. Ongoing training and support to enhance your skills and maximize your potential.

5. Joining a dynamic and inclusive team dedicated to success in the real estate industry.

title: SEO & Website Optimization Specialist
description:
Work with the Content Manager, CEO and the growing marketing team at Adventure Life to develop and implement SEO and AIO strategy on the Adventure Life website and monitor performance to assess these efforts.



Major Duties and Responsibilities:



- Maintain and monitor SEO performance using tools such as SEMrush, Moz, Google Search Console, and other reporting tools used by Adventure Life.

- Develop SEO strategy and help in spearheading website improvement projects such as technical audits, metadata fixes, duplicate content fixes, redirect and broken link fixes, etc. 

- Conduct rank, query, page, and keyword research and analysis for a variety of departments upon request for articles, itineraries, destination pages, and other pages.

- Identify and spearhead copy requests to fill content gaps to maximize SEO potential and search visibility across the website.

- Conduct ongoing destination or theme audits and optimization projects of existing website content to identify inaccuracies and areas for performance improvements.

- Execute and measure optimizations to assess SEO performance of changes. 

- Track top traffic page performance to assess SEO efforts.

- Track keyword database for all ‘owned’ keywords across Adventure Life’s top URLs.

- Manage all incoming website edit requests by staff and coordinate with copywriters, graphic designers, and relevant stakeholders to ensure requests are completed and published.

- Collaborate with Sales/Trip Planners and other internal stakeholders to ensure website content is accurate, relevant, and reflective of current travel expertise and offerings.



Required Skills and Experience:



- Computer literacy, including familiarity with Google Suite tools

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

- Strong knowledge of SEO/AIO principles and keyword research

- Critical thinking, decision-making, and analytics skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Independent work ethic and ability to meet communicated deadlines



Preferred Qualifications:



- A bachelor’s (or equivalent) degree in marketing, communications, or a related field

- 2+ years of relevant experience in digital marketing, content strategy, or SEO

- Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console

- Familiarity with industry-standard software such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Moz, or Screaming Frog

- Travel industry knowledge or experience a plus



This is a full-time, 40 hours/week position scheduled by the Content Manager within Adventure Life business hours of 7AM-7PM Mountain Standard Time Monday through Friday (though schedule flexibility may be possible). This position is fully remote.



If interested, please submit the following: resume, cover letter, and portfolio or samples of related work. References are also encouraged.

title: Social Media Manager (Content creation + Reels + Carousels)
description:
Type of Work: Full-time contractor (independent, not agency) 

Location: Remote / Work from home

Schedule: Flexible hours, weekly deadlines, ~40 hrs/week

Pay: $300–$600 USD/month, based on experience; you'll know your exact rate before you accept



JOB OVERVIEW 

Turn ideas into scroll-stopping content for travel brands, expat families, and rising female coaches.



WHO WE ARE 

We help travel brands inspire unforgettable trips, support families relocating abroad, and empower female online coaches to build authority and scale their businesses. Now we need a dedicated content creator to bring these brands to life on Instagram, one reel, carousel, and story at a time.



IS THIS YOU?

You're not "just" a video editor; you're a storyteller who happens to be sharp in Premiere Pro.

You feel the edit: pacing, music, text timing, the perfect three seconds.

You catch the details others scroll past.

You hit deadlines without being chased.

You're already testing new AI tools before your friends have heard of them.

You bring energy to the work; this isn't a task you're grinding through.

You'll report directly to the CEO/Strategist, working from a content strategy that's already built. No client-facing calls required.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Editing Reels and talking-head content aligned to each brand's voice

Designing Carousels that educate and build authority

Picking trending audio and edit styles that drive retention

Color grading, color correction, and audio balancing

Sourcing natural B-roll and supporting visuals

Building Stories (photos, video, graphics, polls, countdowns)

Writing captions that sound like the brand, not a template

Posting to the content calendar and keeping feeds cohesive

Using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Kling AI, etc.) to move faster

Reviewing analytics and suggesting what to try next



WHAT YOU BRING

A portfolio showing real Instagram work: Reels, Stories, Carousels, captions

Strong Premiere Pro, Canva, and AI creative-tool skills

A real sense of pacing, storytelling, color, and music

An eye for trends that doesn't break brand consistency

Solid time management across multiple accounts and deadlines

Clear, proactive communication and an ownership mindset



WHAT YOU GET

Systems, not chaos. SOPs, workflows, and project management tools already built for you. 

Real creative collaboration.Direct access to the CEO/Strategist, with honest feedback.

Feedback that actually helps you grow: regular, specific, constructive. 

Freedom with accountability. Manage your own schedule. We care about results, not clock-watching. 

Room to grow. Strong performers take on more client accounts as we scale. 



This is a full-time contractor role for an individual. We are not looking for an agency. 



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

A 3–5 minute Loom covering: how you keep branding consistent across content, and one strategy you've used to grow or engage an audience.

A link to your portfolio (Reels, Carousels, Stories).

Your resume.



We read every application closely. To prove you did too, put the word "Pink" right after your first and last name, and make sure "pink" is the very last word of your written application.



We're excited to see what you create.

title: Google & Meta Ads Specialist
description:
Google & Meta Ads Specialist



Client Location: Boston, USA

Job Type: Full-time, Remote

Schedule: Must be available for at least 2 hours during the US Eastern workday, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time.





About Us:

We are a small marketing agency supporting clients across a variety of industries. Many of our tea
mbers have worked with us for years because we value clear communication, steady work, respect, accountability, and a positive team culture.

We are looking for an experienced Google & Meta Ads Specialist who can independently manage paid advertising across multiple client accounts.



This is not an entry-level role. You should already know how to build, manage, troubleshoot, and improve campaigns while staying current with the latest tools, automation, AI features, and strategies on both platforms.

You should be comfortable managing up to 10 clients at a time, with different industries, goals, and advertising budgets.







Job Overview:

As our Google & Meta Ads Specialist, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management and optimization of paid media campaigns across our client portfolio. You will work with our directors, account managers, creative team, and other marketing staff to develop advertising strategies that support each client's business objectives.



Clients may include local service businesses, retail and e-commerce companies, professional services, B2B businesses, and other industries.



Some clients will have relatively modest advertising budgets, while others may have larger budgets and multiple campaigns running simultaneously. You must be able to adjust your strategy appropriately rather than applying the same approach to every account.



A major part of this role is staying current. We expect you to stay informed about changes to Google and Meta best practices, test useful new strategies, and understand when new tools should and should not be used.









Main Responsibilities:



Google Ads:

-Build and optimize Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Demand Gen, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns as appropriate.

-Manage keywords, search terms, negatives, bidding, budgets, targeting, assets, and ad copy.

-Monitor budget pacing, wasted spend, campaign structure, and optimization opportunities.

-Stay current with Google Ads automation, AI tools, bidding strategies, and platform changes.



Meta Ads:

-Build and optimize lead generation, conversion, e-commerce, awareness, and remarketing campaigns.

-Manage audiences, placements, budgets, creative testing, and Advantage+ tools.

-Monitor lead quality, creative fatigue, and campaign efficiency.

-Stay current with Meta platform changes, targeting, AI tools, creative strategies, and measurement updates.



Tracking & Measurement:

-Set up and troubleshoot Google Ads conversions, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API.

-Understand UTMs, attribution, CRM tracking, and call tracking.

-Verify that campaign data is accurate before making optimization decisions.



Strategy & Optimization:

-Develop strategies based on each client's industry, budget, geography, seasonality, and business goals.

-Optimize toward meaningful KPIs such as qualified leads, sales, CPA, ROAS, and revenue.

-Run structured tests and document important changes.

-Recommend improvements to landing pages, offers, creative, or messaging when needed.

-Multi-Client Management

-Manage up to 10 active client accounts with different budgets and priorities.

-Keep budgets, optimizations, tests, and next steps organized.

-Communicate problems early and work independently without constant oversight.



Reporting & Communication:

-Explain what changed, why performance changed, and what should happen next in a simple and clear format

-Prepare internal reporting using tools such as AgencyAnalytics.

-Participate in strategy discussions internally

-Translate campaign data into practical recommendations.

-Prepare external-facing reports based on company format







Qualifications:



Required:

-At least 3 years of hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads experience.

-Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

-Strong knowledge of campaign strategy, optimization, testing, and budget management.

-Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, call tracking, and conversion tracking setup.

-Lead generation and e-commerce campaigns.

-Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

-Excellent written and spoken English.



Preferred:

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

-Marketing agency environments.

-Managing 8–10+ advertising accounts.

-Google Merchant Center.

-Meta Conversions API.

-GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

-AgencyAnalytics

-Google Ads or Meta certifications.







Staying Current:



Paid advertising changes quickly. We expect you to stay informed about new Google and Meta campaign types, AI tools, automation, bidding strategies, targeting changes, creative best practices, attribution, and privacy-related measurement updates.



We also expect good judgment. You should be able to test new tools intelligently rather than automatically adopting every platform recommendation.







Skills We Are Looking For:

-Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.

-Excellent organization and time management.

-Ability to troubleshoot and solve problems independently.

-Ability to explain advertising performance clearly.

-Good judgment and willingness to challenge underperforming strategies.

-Dependability, accountability, curiosity, and a strong work ethic.



Our Work Style:

-We value people who are honest, consistent, thoughtful, and dependable.

-We do not expect every campaign to improve every month, but we do expect you to understand what is happening in the accounts you manage, communicate clearly, test reasonable solutions, and take ownership of your work.



Benefits:

-Part-time remote work with the potential to become full-time.

-Long-term opportunity for the right person.

-Flexible hours with overlap during the US Eastern workday.

-Supportive team environment.

-Opportunity to work across multiple industries and expand your responsibilities over time.







How to Apply:



Please
 your application to:





Use this subject line:

Applying for Google & Meta Ads Specialist - CARROT



Please include:

-Your resume.

-A short cover letter.

-Examples or screenshots of Google Ads or Meta Ads campaigns you have managed, with confidential information removed if necessary.

-A Loom video answering the questions below.



Loom Video Questions

1. Show us a Google Ads or Meta Ads campaign you managed that you are proud of.

Explain the goal, budget, what you changed or tested, the results, and what you would do next.

2. Show us how you would audit a Google Ads or Meta Ads account you have never seen before.

Explain what you would check first, what problems you would look for, and one recent platform change or strategy you think advertisers should be paying attention to.

title: Fitness Coach DM Setter
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



** MUST HAVE PROVEN PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE WITH FITNESS COACH DM SETTING **



**Salary:** Monthly base retainer + performance commission on closed sales (details discussed at interview)



**ABOUT US**



We are a US-based online fitness coaching business. Our founder is a national-level physique competitor and former aerospace engineer, and we help clients transform their health through 16-week coaching programs. We have 95,000+ engaged followers across TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube. Your job is to turn that audience into booked sales calls.



**THE ROLE**



You will be the first human touchpoint for people interested in our coaching. You start genuine conversations in the DMs, build rapport over time, and book warm, qualified leads directly into our founder's Calendly.



This is a relationship-first role. We do NOT want spammy copy-paste blasting. We provide proven templates; you personalize every message and let conversations develop naturally. Rapport first, appointment second.



**WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY**



- Send 200 to 300 outbound DMs per day across our platforms (TikTok is the top priority, then Instagram, then
, then YouTube)

- Personalize our message templates for each person based on their profile and engagement

- Nurture replies at a natural pace and move warm leads toward a sales call

- Book interested leads directly into Calendly

- Write a short summary of every conversation that leads to a booked call

- Log your daily numbers (DMs sent, replies, conversations, calls booked)



**COMPENSATION**



- A guaranteed monthly base retainer, paid regardless of performance, so you always have a stable floor

- Plus performance commission on every booked call that turns into a closed sale. Commission scales with the program tier the client purchases: closing our premium program pays roughly triple what our entry program pays, so nurturing quality leads directly increases your income

- You receive a conversion report every week, so you always know exactly which of your bookings closed and what you've earned

- Total earnings for a consistent performer land well above typical full-time setter rates, with no hard ceiling on the commission side

- Exact figures are shared at the interview stage



Note: commission is paid on CLOSED sales, not just booked calls. This role rewards setters who book genuinely interested people, not calendar-stuffers.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word MACKEREL as the very first word and the subject of the message. Applications that do not start with MACKEREL will be deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who pay attention to detail, which is the #1 skill in this role.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent written English with a natural, conversational American tone

- Must be available to work US hours: approximately 3PM PST to 12PM PST, Tuesday to Saturday. This is a firm requirement; our audience is most active during US afternoons and evenings, and fast reply speed during those hours is core to this role.

- Experience as an appointment setter, DM setter, or chat-based sales role (fitness, coaching, or online business niche is a big plus)

- Comfortable with high daily volume without losing warmth or quality

- Full-time availability, reliable internet, strong self-management

- Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, and
 
 interfaces

- Manychat and Meta Business experience is a plus



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**



- Not a hard-sell or pressure role. If you burn leads by rushing them, this is not the right fit.

- Not a content creation or design role.

- You do not close sales on calls. You book them; our founder closes them.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Your application must include ALL of the following, in this order:



1. The word MACKEREL as the very first word of your application

2. A short intro: your setter/DM experience and the niches you have worked in

3. An example of a conversation that you had with a prospect that shows your ability to validate, relate, lean in, show proof, and set the appointment.

4. Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work full-time on the stated US hours schedule



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.

title: Hubspot Expert
description:
CRM Magnetics is looking for a highly skilled HubSpot Solution Architect to lead complex client implementations and design scalable CRM systems for growing B2B companies.



We specialize in building advanced, high-impact HubSpot ecosystems — not basic setups. This role is for someone who wants to own solutions end-to-end, make decisions, and grow into a true architecture and leadership position.



About the Role

This is not just an execution role.



You will:

- Own full-cycle implementations — from discovery and architecture to delivery and optimization

- Design scalable CRM systems, not just configure tools

- Work directly with clients and influence business processes

- Take responsibility for technical decisions and final outcomes

We’re looking for someone who thinks like a system designer and problem-solver, not just a specialist.



Key Responsibilities:

- Lead end-to-end HubSpot implementations (discovery ? architecture ? delivery ? optimization)

- Translate business needs into scalable CRM and automation solutions

- Design CRM structures, workflows, data models, and reporting systems

- Own solution decisions and ensure best practices across projects

- Manage and guide implementation specialists (task delegation, QA, support)

- Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities in client systems proactively

- Work directly with clients in English (calls, documentation, consulting)

- Handle complex integrations (APIs, third-party tools, custom logic)



Requirements:

- Advanced HubSpot expertise (CRM, workflows, reporting, integrations)

- Proven experience with complex implementations (not just basic setups)

- Strong solution-thinking mindset — ability to design systems

- Experience leading projects or managing tea
mbers

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle non-standard cases

- Fluent English (C1+) — client-facing role

- High ownership, responsibility and attention to detail



Nice to Have:

- RevOps / SalesOps / MarketingOps experience

- APIs, Zapier / Make, custom integrations

- SaaS / B2B background

- Experience designing scalable CRM architectures



Compensation & Growth

- Starting rate: $14/hour (Solutions Architect in Training)

- Training period is performance-based — no fixed timeline

- As soon as you demonstrate the ability to independently own projects ? immediate promotion and pay increase ($18+/hour)



We don’t slow people down — growth is based purely on capability and results.



Growth & Opportunity



We are a fast-growing agency with strong 
ntum.



Our systems are already structured, and we’re actively improving:

- Documentation

- Operational efficiency

- Automation and AI deployment



This role is not capped.



The right person will have the opportunity to:

1) Shape internal processes and technical standards

2) Influence how solutions are designed across the company

3) Grow into leadership roles such as:

- Implementation Team Lead

- Head of Solutions Architecture

- Future executive-level roles as the company scales



Who We’re Looking For



Someone who:

- Doesn’t wait for instructions — finds solutions independently

- Can take full ownership of projects and drive them to completion

- Understands business logic, not just tools

- Thinks like an architect, not just a technician

- Wants to join early, grow fast, and build something meaningful



If you're a strong HubSpot expert ready to step into a true architecture and leadership track, we’d love to hear from you.



How to Apply



To be considered for this role, please include:



1) 2–4 relevant HubSpot projects or case studies you’ve worked on

2) A brief description of:

- The client/business context

- What you were responsible for

- The solution you designed and implemented

3) Any links, screenshots, or Loom walkthroughs (if available)



Applications without relevant project examples will not be considered.



We will not consider candidates without experience at Hubspot or without case studies.

title: AI-Powered Focused Social Media Manager. Build Traffic. Drive Sales. Social Media Growth
description:
About the Role



Prodigy Media is looking for an AI Marketing Systems & Growth Manager to build the AI-powered marketing engine behind our brands.



This is not a traditional social media manager position. We need someone who understands marketing, but also thinks like a systems builder. You will use AI, automation, agents and creative technology to build repeatable systems that generate brand awareness, engagement, qualified traffic and sales.



We currently operate more than 10 brands. The initial focus will be on building one brand from the ground up, proving the system and producing measurable results. Once the model works, we will scale it across the rest of our portfolio.



The objective is straightforward: build an AI-powered marketing operation that drives customers to Shopify, grows TikTok Shop sales and creates additional demand that carries over to Amazon.



What You Will Build



You will be responsible for developing an interconnected marketing system that includes:



AI marketing agents and specialized subagents

Automated content research and production workflows

Social media content calendars and publishing systems

Short-form video and advertising production pipelines

TikTok, Instagram and
 growth systems

TikTok Shop customer acquisition campaigns

Shopify landing pages and conversion funnels

 capture, nurturing and promotional systems

Paid advertising campaigns across TikTok and Meta

Performance tracking, testing and optimization workflows

Systems for repurposing winning creative across multiple channels

Documentation that allows successful systems to be duplicated across additional brands



Core Responsibilities



AI Systems and Workflow Development

Use Claude Cowork as a primary workspace for building and operating marketing systems.

Build AI agents, subagents, skills, instructions and repeatable workflows for research, strategy, content creation, campaign execution and reporting.

Develop structured systems using Claude, Codex, Visual Studio or VS Code, APIs and automation platforms.

Connect tools and workflows so that marketing activities can be executed faster and with less repetitive manual work.

Maintain organized knowledge bases containing brand positioning, customer research, creative standards, winning content and campaign insights.

Continuously test new AI capabilities and determine how they can improve output, speed, consistency or profitability.





Social Media and Brand Growth

Build the brand’s presence across TikTok, Instagram and
.

Develop content strategies designed to generate awareness, engagement, followers, traffic and sales.

Research customer behavior, trends, competitors, hooks, formats and creative angles.

Create systems for producing and testing content consistently.

Build community engagement workflows that turn comments, conversations and customer feedback into growth opportunities.

Identify winning content and scale it across platforms without making every channel feel identical.





AI Creative Production

Produce AI-assisted product videos, UGC-style content, direct-response ads and branded creative.

Use tools such as Higgsfield, Claude Design, Codex and other emerging AI creative platforms.

Build repeatable creative pipelines covering concepts, scripts, storyboards, prompts, production, editing and variations.

Maintain brand consistency across characters, messaging, visual style, tone and offers.

Generate multiple creative variations quickly and use campaign data to determine what should be improved or scaled.





Paid Advertising and Customer Acquisition

Plan, launch and optimize advertising campaigns across TikTok and Meta.

Use paid traffic to drive customers to Shopify and TikTok Shop.

Develop campaign structures covering prospecting, retargeting, creative testing and offer testing.

Track performance metrics including CPM, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPA, ROAS and revenue.

Translate campaign results into clear creative and funnel improvements.

Understand how off-Amazon traffic and brand awareness can create additional demand for Amazon listings.





Shopify, Landing Pages and
 Marketing

Build and improve Shopify landing pages designed around specific audiences, problems and offers.

Create conversion-focused product pages, advertorials, lead-generation pages and promotional funnels.

Build
 capture, welcome, abandoned-cart, post-purchase, educational and promotional sequences.

Use testing and customer behavior data to improve conversion rates and customer value.

Ensure messaging remains consistent from the advertisement through the landing page, checkout and follow-up communication.

What Success Looks Like



The first stage of this role will focus on one selected brand. Success will be measured by the ability to:



Build a functional AI-powered marketing system from the ground up.

Establish a consistent production pipeline for organic and paid creative.

Grow qualified engagement and brand awareness across social platforms.

Generate measurable Shopify and TikTok Shop traffic and sales.

Improve advertising performance through disciplined testing.

Build landing pages and
 systems that convert traffic into customers.

Identify repeatable strategies that can be documented and scaled across our other brands.

Reduce the time and manual effort required to research, create, launch and optimize campaigns.





Required Experience

Proven experience marketing products through TikTok, Instagram and
.

Practical experience with TikTok Shop and direct-response e-commerce marketing.

Experience running or supporting TikTok Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

Understanding of Shopify, landing pages, conversion funnels and
 marketing.

Strong knowledge of short-form content, hooks, creative testing and social media engagement.

Experience using AI tools to produce marketing content, creative assets or automated workflows.

Ability to analyze performance data and make decisions based on results.

Strong written communication, organization and documentation skills.

Ability to work independently, move quickly and take ownership of outcomes.





Strongly Preferred

Advanced experience with Claude, particularly Claude Cowork.

Experience building agents, subagents, skills, prompts and multi-step AI workflows.

Working knowledge of Codex, Visual Studio or VS Code, APIs, MCP connections and automation tools.

Experience creating AI-generated videos and advertisements with Higgsfield or similar platforms.

Experience building and scaling a consumer brand outside Amazon.

Experience connecting social media, paid advertising, Shopify,
 and Amazon into one customer-acquisition strategy.

Familiarity with Amazon private-label brands and the relationship between external demand and Amazon sales.

Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who believes marketing has fundamentally changed and wants to operate at the forefront of that change.



You should be excited by the opportunity to combine marketing strategy, AI systems, automation, content production and paid advertising. You do not need to know every platform on day one, but you must be willing to learn quickly, experiment intelligently and turn new capabilities into real business results.



You are likely a strong fit if you:



Think in systems instead of isolated tasks.

Are comfortable building something that does not already exist.

Take ownership without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

Learn new AI tools quickly and apply them to real campaigns.

Understand that impressive creative means nothing if it does not generate attention, traffic or sales.

Can balance experimentation with disciplined performance measurement.

Are energized by change instead of threatened by it.

Want access to advanced AI tools and the freedom to use them creatively.

Are ready for a serious challenge with the opportunity to shape how multiple brands are built and marketed.



If you are up for a rewarding role with learning skills that will carry you beyond your role, please
 me directly with the subject line "I'm a Marketing Magician". to 



Regards,

Tam Ma

Co Founder, Prodigy Media

 addresses, websites, and social media profiles

description:

About the Role

Ape Born Fitness is hiring a Support & Retention Specialist to own our front-line customer experience. Your #1 mission: save customers before they refund. You'll handle inbound support across phone,
, and SMS, make outbound retention calls, and manage chargeback disputes end to end.

Manage
 and SMS support tickets in Gorgias

title: Programme & Events Manager
description:
Reports to: CEO

Works closely with: CEO, Advisory Board, Digital Operations Lead, pilot clients, event partners and speakers

Location: Remote - Philippines-based candidates

Team: UK and Philippines-based

Hours: Full-time (37.5 hours), 8:30am–5:00pm UK time



ABOUT SUPERWELLNESS



Founded in 2011, SuperWellness has worked with over 1,500 organisations on workplace wellbeing. Along the way, we've come to believe the industry has had it slightly wrong: wellbeing has too often been treated as a separate concern from performance — focused on minimising risk and supporting those in crisis — rather than as two sides of the same coin. Our mission is to help organisations build compassionate, high-performance cultures — where good work is celebrated not just for preventing harm, but for enabling people and organisations to genuinely flourish. That mission is what's driving the launch of an exciting new programme and the events built around it.

We're just as invested in the growth of our own team. We focus on developing our people and bringing out their potential, and we value initiative, creativity, and people who actively want to contribute to our mission rather than simply carry out tasks.



ABOUT THE ROLE



SuperWellness is launching an exciting new workplace wellbeing programme, alongside a flagship summit bringing together around 100 senior leaders in London in February 2027.

We're looking for someone to project-manage this launch from the ground up — coordinating the moving parts across our Advisory Board, pilot clients, partners, and the summit itself — and then to take ongoing ownership of the programme once launched: managing it year-round, and planning and delivering future events. This is a permanent role built around a major first-year launch, not a fixed-term project. You'll work closely with the CEO on the commercial and strategic decisions that shape it. It's not a role where you wait to be told what to do next — it's a role where you own workstreams, spot what needs attention before it becomes a problem, and bring your own judgement to how things should be done.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Launch project management

• Project manage the end-to-end launch of the programme and the delivery of the launch summit (4 February 2027, London) — timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk-flagging

• Set up and maintain reporting on launch progress and event take-up, keeping the CEO informed of where things stand and what needs a decision



Ongoing programme management

• Once launched, take ownership of managing the programme year-round

• Plan and project manage future events on an ongoing basis, applying the same reporting and delivery approach used for the launch



Advisory board coordination

• Liaise with Advisory Board members to coordinate meeting dates and diaries

• Coordinate board members' input into the framework and supporting documentation

• Support board members' social media activity connected to the launch and future events



Partnership & sponsorship

• Help develop and progress partnership and sponsorship opportunities alongside the CEO

• Support outreach, follow-up, and coordination with prospective partners



Pilot client liaison

• Liaise with pilot clients on deadlines through the programme process

• Coordinate queries and support to keep pilot clients on track to completion



Event delivery

• Liaise with the venue, speakers, and other stakeholders for the launch summit and future events on logistics and requirements



Marketing & communications

• Project manage marketing communications around the launch and future events — social media,
 campaigns, and PR — working closely with the CEO and Digital Operations Lead



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



This is a project ownership role, not an administrative one. We're looking for someone who can learn quickly under guidance, take genuine ownership of significant parts of the launch, and add value by contributing their own thinking — not just executing instructions.



• Proven project management experience — you have managed a significant project before, ideally something comparable in scale and complexity to a conference, product launch, or major campaign

• Extremely well organised — juggling multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines without things slipping through the cracks is second nature to you

• Fully fluent in English, with an excellent command of written English — able to tailor AI-generated content so it sounds authentic and reflects our brand's voice, not generic or robotic

• High level of business and commercial awareness — you understand how partnerships, sponsorship, and programme delivery create value, and you bring that awareness to how you handle every conversation

• Highly proactive and able to work independently — comfortable making decisions without close supervision, and confident enough to challenge existing approaches and bring new ideas to the table rather than just following instructions

• Comfortable liaising directly and confidently with senior stakeholders — board members, sponsors, and pilot clients — representing the brand professionally

• A self-starter who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next



Please note: this role requires genuine project ownership and independent judgement. If you are looking for a purely administrative or task-execution role, this is unlikely to be the right fit.



WORKING HERE



• This is a remote role working closely with a small, fast-moving UK and Philippines-based team — expect regular real-time collaboration during UK hours

• You will be expected to provide your own professional-spec, reliable equipment — a capable laptop, stable broadband connection, and a suitable working environment. Salary is set to reflect that no equipment allowance is provided

• You'll be working on something genuinely new — a major programme launched from the ground up — with real scope to shape how it's delivered



SALARY & BENEFITS



• $1,200–$1,500 per month, depending on experience

• Quarterly profit-related bonus, tied to your personal KPIs as well as overall company performance

• Growth shares after 6 months — eligibility to join our growth share scheme, giving you a stake in the company's long-term growth

• HMO cover after 6 months



HOW TO APPLY



To apply for this position, please complete this application form: 



Please note that only candidates who fully complete the application form will be considered for the role. Please do not apply directly via onlinejobs.ph as your application will not be considered.



Stage 1 — Application, including our application form, a CV, cover letter, and a short video

Stage 2 — Initial 10-minute video call with our Administration Manager

Stage 3 — Test tasks

Stage 4 — Interview with the CEO and other members of the team



We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis. Should your qualifications align with our requirements, we will be in touch with the next steps.

mber of a growing team

Complete compensation and performance bonus details will be discussed during the interview process and documented in the written contractor agreement.



Speed to Lead



MedSpa Advertising places a very high value on response time.



During staffed coverage hours, you will be expected to call every new lead within five minutes whenever reasonably possible. If you are already speaking with another prospective patient, finish that conversation professionally and contact the next lead immediately afterward.



Consistent responsiveness, lead queue monitoring, and timely follow-up are core performance expectations for this position.



Required Internet, Equipment, and Workspace



You must have:

A quiet, private, and professional working environment

A quality USB headset with clear audio and a noise-reducing microphone

Reliable high-speed internet with a minimum speed of 20 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload

Two monitors or the ability to have a two-monitor setup by your start date

Finalists may be asked to demonstrate their internet speed, workstation, audio quality, and backup plan.



Communication Expectations



You will be expected to:

Respond promptly to work-related messages

Communicate clearly during shift handoffs

Attend required training, coaching, and tea
etings when scheduled





Experience

Inside sales

HighLevel

Performance Expectations



Performance will be evaluated based on:

Appointment show rate

Call quality and professionalism

Adherence to approved call frameworks and policies

CRM and EMR accuracy

Attendance and punctuality

Responsiveness and internal communication

Prospective patient experience

Coachability and improvement over time





Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is a paid, hourly independent contractor position. It is not a U.S. W-2 employee position.



We are building this team for long-term growth. Tea
mbers who consistently perform well may have opportunities to receive additional hours, take on greater responsibility, help train future Patient Scheduling Specialists, and pursue leadership opportunities as the team expands.

title: Experienced Google Ads Specialist | Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
We are looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to take ownership of Google Ads for Skyline School, a U.S.-based professional education company. This is a long-term, part-time specialist position—not a general virtual assistant or social media marketing role.



Our goal is simple: generate more profitable online course registrations while reducing wasted advertising spend.



We are looking for someone who can independently analyze an account, identify problems and opportunities, make thoughtful optimizations, test ideas, and explain the reasoning behind their decisions. We do NOT want someone who simply checks the account, automatically applies Google's recommendations, or sends reports without taking action.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Manage and optimize our Google Ads campaigns — analyze campaign, ad group, keyword, search-term, audience, geographic, device, bidding, and budget performance and make data-driven improvements.

Improve traffic quality and eliminate wasted spend — regularly review search terms, manage negative keywords and match types, identify irrelevant traffic, and determine where budget should be increased, reduced, or reallocated.

Optimize for actual business results — focus on purchases, revenue, CPA, ROAS and profitable growth rather than clicks, impressions or Google's Optimization Score.

Own measurement and conversion tracking — audit and troubleshoot Google Ads conversion tracking and work confidently with GA4 and Google Tag Manager to make sure purchases and purchase values are being measured correctly.

Continuously test and improve performance — write/test search ads, identify new keyword and campaign opportunities, evaluate bidding strategies, and flag landing-page or checkout issues that may be reducing conversions.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



• 2+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience managing campaigns yourself

• Strong experience with Google Search campaigns and conversion-focused PPC optimization

• Strong understanding of search terms, negative keywords, match types, bidding strategies, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate and conversion value

• Experience with Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4 and Google Tag Manager

• Excellent analytical judgment and the ability to clearly explain WHY you are making a change



Experience advertising for U.S. businesses, e-commerce, online education, professional services or other direct-response businesses is a plus.



Google Ads certifications are welcome, but demonstrated ability is much more important to us than certifications.



IMPORTANT:



We want a proactive specialist who can work independently. If you believe something should be changed, we want you to tell us. If you believe something should NOT be changed yet because there isn't enough data, we want you to tell us that too.



SCHEDULE



This is a long-term part-time position. Expect approximately 4–6 hours per week on an ongoing basis, with the opportunity for 8–10 hours per week during the initial account audit and optimization period.



Hours are flexible. You do not need to work U.S. business hours, although you should be responsive to messages and available for occasional scheduled meetings.



COMPENSATION



$8–$10 USD/hour depending on experience.



We are looking for the right person for a long-term working relationship. Compensation may be reviewed as responsibilities and results grow.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please begin your application with:



SKYLINE PPC



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.



Then answer the following in your application message:

title: WordPress & Marketing Ops Generalist
description:
About the role



We run a small group of digital properties - several content and business websites, an online training program, and we're also building a B2B app - and need one reliable full-time generalist to own the publishing and marketing-ops execution across all of them. You won't be writing the content or coming up with the strategy; you'll be the person who takes the material and take it to the finish line.



This is an execution role, not a strategy role. You'll work from clear direction and existing systems, not figure out what to publish or why.



What you'll do



A quick note before you read this list: yes, it covers a few different skills, and we know that can look like we're asking for a unicorn. We're not delusional. There's only a couple of things you need to already be genuinely good at — WordPress publishing and Canva. Everything else below is either a small part of the job or something we're fully willing to train. You don't need to walk in mastering all of it.



- Publish articles and pages to WordPress across multiple company websites: correct formatting, media, categories/tags, and on-page SEO fields (Yoast/RankMath), every time, without needing a second pass.

- Support an online course platform: assembling and polishing slide decks in Canva (including basic animation), and doing light video editing, mainly syncing voice-over to slide transitions.

- Post and manage content on
 and other social media profiles across our properties.

- Provide general marketing execution support for websites and a newer app project — WordPress publishing and social posting (not product or development work).

- Work inside existing spreadsheets that feed our content pipeline. Updating trackers and status, not building the automation itself.

- Take content-hub admin (publishing, organizing, maintaining the pipeline) off our SEO specialist's plate so they can focus on higher-level SEO work.

- Execute specific technical SEO fixes as directed by our SEO specialist — for example, implementing 301 redirects we've identified. You'll follow clear instructions on what and where; you won't be diagnosing issues yourself.



What you need



- Strong, proven WordPress publishing experience. This is the core requirement — you should be fast, accurate, and independent in WordPress, comfortable with SEO plugins, media, and formatting, without training. If you don't have real WordPress experience already, this isn't the right role for you.

- Huge bonus: experience with Elementor or Thrive Themes (front-end, drag-and-drop page builders). Not required, but candidates with this will stand out.

- Comfortable using Canva for slide decks (animation/polish is a plus, not required on day one).

- Basic video editing skills (Capcut or similar) — nothing advanced, mainly cuts and syncing audio to slide transitions.

- Clean, clear written English — good enough for captions and light copy, not a professional writing bar.

- Reliable, organized, and comfortable working from a spreadsheet-based system without needing to build one yourself.



What this role is not



- Not a content writing or copywriting role — content is written for you.

- Not a technical SEO role — you'll execute specific fixes we hand you (e.g. implementing a 301 redirect we've identified), but you won't be diagnosing issues or d
 what needs fixing. That stays with our SEO specialist. This will be a very minor part of the job.

- Not a link building role.

- Not an automation building role.

- Not a graphic design role

- Not product or development work, even on the app project.



Success in the first 90 days looks like



- Publishing independently and accurately across all company websites with minimal QA needed.

- Producing content using our Content Hub with little to no supervision

- Delivering a polished, animated slide deck for a major upcoming launch.



How to apply



Send the following:



- Your resume.

- A portfolio or work samples, if you have any — WordPress sites you've published on are especially relevant, or Canva slides you made for a previous project.

- An
 with an interesting subject line. We're screening for attention to detail and initiative from the very first message, so a generic subject line ("Application for Marketing Role") won't stand out .

title: Appointment Setter, US Cold Calling, Evening Shift (Part Time)
description:
We are a small marketing company in Tampa, Florida. We are hiring one appointment setter to call small business owners here and book short phone meetings for our sales guys. This is not a call center. You will be the only setter, working directly with the owner of the company.



WHAT YOU ARE SETTING UP

Our clients are local contractors. Roofers, plumbers, air conditioning companies. People used to Google for those services. Now a lot of them just ask AI. When they ask, AI names one or two companies, and it does not name our prospect. Their marketing guy handles Google. Nobody is handling the AI part. That is the whole conversation.



You are not selling. You never quote a price. Your only job is to get the owner to agree to a fifteen minute phone call with one of our guys, and to write down four things: his name, his business name, his best number, and the day and time he agreed to.



THE SHIFT

Business owners in Tampa are in trucks all day, so we catch them early. The window that matters is 7:30am to 10:00am Tampa time.



Manila is exactly 12 hours ahead of Tampa. That makes your shift 7:30pm to 10:00pm Manila time, Monday to Friday.



That is an evening shift, not a graveyard shift. You are done by 10pm your time. Roughly four hours a day, five days a week, twenty hours total.



THE PAY

USD 5.50 per hour, 20 hours per week. That is about USD 440 per month. Plus USD 50 for every appointment you book that actually shows up.



Book two a week and you are earning more than a full time setter.



Paid twice a month through Wise. Hours tracked with TimeProof. The first two weeks are a paid trial at 10 hours per week, same hourly rate, same bonus. If it is working after two weeks we move you to the full 20.



WHAT YOU GET FROM US

A written list of leads with the owner's name and phone number already found for you. A one line hook for each lead, so you never have to invent an opener. A one page script with the exact words, the objections, and the answers. You will not be handed a phone book and told good luck.



REQUIREMENTS

1. Excellent spoken English. Neutral accent. You will be talking to American business owners who will hang up on anyone hard to understand.

2. Real cold calling experience into the US market. Tell us who you called and what you were setting.

3. Your own quiet place to work. No roosters, no traffic, no family in the background.

4. A proper headset. Not laptop speakers, not earbuds.

5. Stable internet with a backup. Power outage plan.

6. Comfortable with a dialer and with logging every call in a web based lead board. If you have used one before, name it.

7. You can be online every weekday 7:30pm to 10:00pm Manila time, reliably.



NICE TO HAVE

We are looking for someone who has the following MUST-HAVE qualifications:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Minimum 12 months of experience in the UK property sector

* Previous experience in property maintenance and repairs processes and terminology

* Experience managing a handyman or contractor diary

* Good geographical awareness and ability to use online maps for scheduling

* Confident and professional on the phone, not transactional but empathetic and skilled at building relationships with tenants, landlords, contractors, and internal teams.

* Strong problem-solving and questioning skills

* Excellent organisational and time-management skills

* Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently

* Assertive and confident while remaining polite, professional, and fair

* Proficient with WhatsApp and other communication tools.



Your main responsibilities will be to:



* Monitor the repairs inbox, voi
s, and WhatsApp, prioritising emergency, urgent, and routine repairs

* Answer calls, identify the issue, and record the caller, property, and repair details

* Log every repair and update in Alto CRM to maintain a complete record

* Contact tenants to gather detailed information, photos, videos, and other relevant details about repairs

* Coordinate tenant access through keys, access codes, or scheduled appointments

* Manage the Handyman’s daily diary, ensuring addresses, access, materials, and job details are confirmed

* Optimise schedules based on property locations, travel time, and appointment availability

* Identify and resolve scheduling gaps or clashes before the Handyman starts work

* Book the Handyman or appropriate contractors for maintenance jobs

* Obtain quotes, confirm costs, and secure landlord approval before arranging chargeable work

* Assign qualified contractors for specialist work such as gas, electrical, and roofing

* Order required materials and ensure they are available before scheduled work

* Monitor ongoing repairs and follow up with the Handyman, contractors, tenants, and landlords

* Request completion updates, photos, certificates, and relevant job documentation

* Manage additional work by obtaining updated quotes and approval before proceeding

* Confirm completed repairs with tenants and ensure they are satisfied with the work

* Update Alto CRM and maintain an accurate audit trail of repairs, costs, communications, and documents

* Follow up on delayed or stalled repairs until they are properly resolved

* Track compliance certificates, inspections, and other property management requirements as needed

* Support property inspections, check-ins, check-outs, inventories, and end-of-tenancy repairs when required

* Keep contractor records, qualifications, insurance, and relevant documentation organised

* Monitor Handyman stock, mileage, parking, charging, and other operational requirements

* Act as a reliable point of contact for tenants, landlords, contractors, the Handyman, and the internal team

* Handle complaints calmly and professionally and ensure they are properly logged and followed through

* Provide concise updates and weekly summaries on outstanding repairs, spending, and matters requiring a decision

* Communicate primarily by phone for urgent or complex matters, using short
s or WhatsApp messages to confirm and document actions

* Take ownership of maintenance issues and proactively escalate matters when further approval or support is required



Additional, Nice-to-have qualifications:



* Experience using Alto CRM

* Experience with tenant referencing or arranging property viewings

* Ability to gradually take on broader property management responsibilities as the role develops

title: Administrative & Client Support Assistant
description:
About the role:

We're a digital marketing agency serving home service businesses (electricians, garage door companies, pressure washers, coatings and window cleaning contractors). About 150 accounts and growing.



This role is the front door. You're the first person a client reaches when they call,
, or hit the chat widget. Most of what comes in is routine and you'll handle it start to finish. The rest you'll route to the right account manager, ad buyer, or automation specialist and then make sure it actually gets closed out.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership of the small stuff so nothing slips. If you like clean inboxes, tidy records, and closing loops, you'll do well here.



What you'll be doing:



Phone and communication

- Answer inbound calls during business hours — clients, vendors, and occasional prospects

- Take clear messages, route calls to the right person, and follow up so nothing dies in a voi

- Return missed calls and respond to inbound leads quickly (speed matters in this industry)




 and inbox management

- Own shared inboxes: triage, sort, label, respond, escalate

- Draft and send routine client communications

- Track outstanding threads and chase down responses (internally and externally)



Chat and support

- Monitor and respond to live chat messages with in 1 minute

- Resolve Tier-1 support inquiries: login and access issues, contact and record lookups, basic "how do I" questions about our platform, small requests for changes or updates

- Write up anything you can't resolve with enough detail that the next person doesn't have to ask twice

- Flag recurring issues so we can fix the root cause instead of answering the same question forty times



Data entry and records

- Enter and update records in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Clean up imports, catch and merge duplicates, fix bad or missing data

- Help maintain client-facing spreadsheets and reporting docs

- Basic QA: if something looks wrong, say so before it goes to a client



Coordination

- Schedule and confirm client calls and internal meetings

- Keep tasks updated in ClickUp so status is visible without anyone having to ask

- Document what you do as you do it 



What we're looking for

- 1+ years in an administrative, customer service, virtual assistant, or support role

- Excellent written and spoken English - you'll be on the phone and in writing with US business owners every day

- Comfortable on the phone. Not scared of it, not robotic on it

- Genuinely organized. You use lists, systems, and follow-ups because you want to, not because someone makes you

- Solid with Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Gmail) and quick to pick up new software

- Detail-oriented with data entry (accuracy over speed)

- Helps point out things that could be better rather than just going with the flow. You like to be a part of the growth 

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and a headset for calls

- Available the full 9–6 EST window, consistently



Bonus points

- GoHighLevel experience: this is our CRM. Familiarity is a real advantage

- ClickUp, Zapier, or similar tools

- Experience in the home services or trades industry

- Prior work at a marketing agency or with US-based small business clients

- Any support ticketing or help desk background



Why work with us

- Small team, you'll talk to and work directly with leadership

- Clear expectations and honest feedback, not surprise performance reviews

- Real room to grow. Our best people started narrow and expanded into account management, automation, and operations. Many of our tea
mbers have been with us for 3+ years are not in the same position they started in. 

- We fix broken processes instead of asking people to work around them



If you've read this far, you're already a step ahead of most applicants. Do not apply through this job board. Applications submitted here will not be reviewed. Instead, complete our hiring form: 



It takes about 5 minutes. It asks about your experience with phones,
, and chat support, your CRM background, and your availability.



This is the only way to be considered. If you don't complete the form, your application won't move forward. To be direct about it, this role lives and dies on attention to detail. Following instructions here is the first test.



We look forward to chatting with you!

title: Recruiter / Closer — Run 1-on-1 Interviews for US Roofing Sales Teams (Night Shift, $1,000/mo + Uncapped Bonus)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:



We’re Building With Systems. We build door-to-door sales teams for roofing companies across the US. You’ll be the person who d
 who makes it onto those teams.



This is not a screening job. You own the candidate from first text to first day on the job.



What you’ll actually do



 • Post and refresh job listings on Indeed for our client roster

 • Work the applicant inbox daily — every new applicant contacted within 24 hours

 • Text-qualify candidates before they ever get a calendar slot (short, human, 3–4 disqualifying questions)

 • Run 1-on-1 video interviews with the ones who pass — you make the yes or no

 • Sell the opportunity after they qualify, not before

 • Hand qualified candidates to the client and keep them warm until day one

 • Keep the GHL pipeline accurate daily and send a written end-of-day update



There are no group calls in this role. Every candidate conversation is one-on-one, which means your judgment carries the whole thing.



Who this is for



You’ve sold something before and you’re good at it. You can read a person in ten minutes and know if they’ll still be there in three weeks. You’re comfortable telling someone no, and just as comfortable getting a skeptical experienced salesperson excited about a job he wasn’t looking for.



You need to be sharp on camera. Clear English, real energy, professional background. Half this job is someone d
 whether to trust you through a screen.



Requirements



 • Strong spoken English — you’ll be on video with Americans every day

 • Prior sales, recruiting, or high-volume phone/appointment experience

 • Own computer, HD webcam, headset, primary internet + working backup

 • Quiet, professional space with a clean background

 • Able to work US Eastern hours consistently



Schedule — read this carefully



Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Eastern. That is 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila time. This is a night shift — our candidates and clients are in the US. The rate reflects that. Please do not apply if you can’t hold these hours long-term.



Pay

 • $1,000 USD/month base, paid semi-monthly (Wise or PayPal)

title: Media Buyer / Paid Ads Manager (AI-Assisted) — Remote
description:
Media Buyer / Paid Ads Manager (AI-Assisted) — Remote

PWRD Media | Full-time | $7–$8/hour | 9:00am–5:00pm US Eastern (some flexibility)



About us

PWRD Media is a lead-generation agency for insurance agencies and financial advisors across the US. We run Meta lead campaigns for 20+ client accounts, deliver leads into their CRM, and report performance through our own in-house client dashboard. We operate on documented SOPs and we move fast.



About the role

This is not a traditional media buying job. We have an AI system (Viktor) that pulls performance data, builds campaigns, generates creatives, and flags underperforming ads. Your job is to run that system and own the outcome. You review and approve what it produces, make sure every account is set up correctly and hitting its cost-per-lead target, and keep the dashboard accurate. You are the human quality gate between our AI and our clients' ad spend.



Right now our founder is still doing this work. We're hiring you so he never has to touch an ad account again.



What you'll do

Own campaign setup for every new client onboarding — build the campaign to our SOP (objective, CBO ad sets, geo/radius targeting, lead form with the correct qualifying questions, tracking, naming conventions) so it goes live within the onboarding window, correct the first time.

Review and approve all ad creatives before they go live — check the offer, hook, copy variants, and compliance requirements, and reject anything off-brief.

Daily performance management — review every account against its CPL / CTR / frequency / lead-quality targets, pause losers, scale winners, and keep budgets aligned to what the client is paying for.

Run the kill-and-replace loop — as we automate pausing any ad below KPI, you'll own the process: confirm the kill decision, request or approve replacement creatives, keep the tested/approved creative library organised, and log what worked and what didn't.

Keep our dashboard accurate — make sure spend, leads, CPL and campaign status are correct for every client, and flag anything broken (delivery errors, disapproved ads, lead forms not firing) immediately.

Work alongside the AI system daily — action its recommendations, catch what it gets wrong, and give clear feedback so the system gets sharper over time.

Support the client-facing team — supply performance numbers and plain-English explanations for check-in calls. You won't be on client calls (our Client Success team owns that), but they rely on you for the truth of what's happening in the accounts.

Follow the SOPs exactly. If you think an SOP should change, you propose the change — you don't quietly freelance.





What we're looking for

2+ years hands-on Meta Ads experience 
/Instagram lead generation preferred). Lead forms, Business Manager, pixel/CAPI basics, ad account structure.

Comfortable being judged on numbers: cost per lead, lead quality, spend efficiency.

Genuinely comfortable working with AI tools — reviewing AI output critically rather than either rubber-stamping it or fighting it.

Extremely organised and detail-obsessed. Wrong geo, wrong lead form, wrong budget = a client loses money.

Excellent written English and proactive communication in Slack. You flag problems early instead of hiding them.

Self-managing. You'll work independently inside our systems without being chased.





Nice to have

Experience in the US insurance, financial services, or home services verticals.

Google Ads or LinkedIn Ads experience.

Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRMs.

Experience with creative testing frameworks and structured naming/tagging systems.





Details

Hours: 9:00am–5:00pm US Eastern, Monday–Friday (negotiable, but overlap with Eastern business hours is required).

Pay: $7–$8 USD/hour depending on experience.

Location: Fully remote.
