title: Operations Manager - Own Delivery For A Growing Remote Team (Real Authority, You Set The Cadence)
description:
I run a small remote team across dev, marketing, creative and sales. It's growing - I have several

hires in the pipeline right now. My problem is not talent. My problem is me.



Everything routes through my head. What each person should work on next, whether the thing promised

last Tuesday actually shipped, who is sitting idle waiting on an answer fro
. I am the bottleneck,

and I am spending my week chasing instead of doing what I'm actually good at - setting direction and

testing new ideas fast.



I want to hand that entire problem to one person.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



Throughput. That's it, and it's everything:



- Every person on this team always has clear work in front of them, deep enough that nobody ever runs

  dry waiting to be told what's next.

- Every project has a named owner and a date. Things that stall get caught by you, not discovered by

  me three weeks later.

- People who miss deadlines hear about it from you. Directly, early, without drama.

- The small decisions stop reaching me. You batch them, pre-d
 them, or just make the call.

- Anything we do more than twice gets written down so the next person can do it without asking.



I'm paying for outcomes, not hours logged. I don't want a timesheet and I won't be counting your

minutes. I want the team moving.



THE PART MOST PEOPLE GET WRONG



I am not hiring someone to sit online all day and answer messages. That would just replace one

bottleneck with a slower one - I answer in four hours, you'd answer Wednesday.



I'm hiring someone who builds a machine that runs when they're NOT there. Which means:



- Everyone's queue is deeper than the gap until you next check in. Nobody can run out of work.

- Blocked people unblock themselves, because you set standing rules and limits in advance instead of

  being the person they wait on.

- You spot someone under-delivering from their OUTPUT - missed dates on visible work - not from

  watching whether they're online.



The version of this role that fails is the one where you show up Friday and tell me what broke on

Tuesday. The system has to catch it on Tuesday, without you.



FIRST 30 DAYS



Get everything out of my head. Every open project, half-started idea, and promise I made to someone,

into one place with an owner and a date attached. Talk to every person on the team and find out what

they're ACTUALLY working on versus what I think they're working on. Then tell me, in writing, who's

idle, what's stalled, and what has no owner. That report is your first deliverable and I expect it to

be uncomfortable reading.



WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT



You get real authority on day one, and I tell the team so. You set deadlines. You reassign work. You

reject deliverables that aren't finished. You escalate, and it means something. I've seen the version

of this role where someone just sends status updates and politely nags - that's useless to both of us.



You also pick your own tools. There is no system to inherit. No Asana instance, no legacy board with

400 dead cards. You build the way this team runs, from zero, however you think it should work. That

is deliberate, and yes, it's part of how I'll judge you.



And I want to be pushed back on. When I send you an idea at 6am that doesn't deserve to jump the

queue, the right answer is "not this week, here's why." If you can't do that part, the rest doesn't

matter.



WHO THIS FITS



- You've kept a team moving without being available in real time - fractional work, several clients,

  or a big timezone gap. You've already solved this problem for someone else.

- You've built a work system from scratch that a real team adopted and kept using after you stopped

  pushing it

- You've actually held remote contractors to deadlines, not just tracked them

- You manage people in writing, clearly and briefly, because that's where all of this happens

- You've told a boss "no, that's not worth doing" and been right

- You'd rather delete a process than add one



WHAT YOU GET



$500/month to start, growing with results as the team grows. You design your own working rhythm -

which days, which sessions, how long. Direct line to me. Full ownership of how this operation runs.

If this works, this role becomes chief of staff: you take over priority calls and team performance

directly, and I stay in my lane.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with NOBODY IDLE in capital letters, first line, nothing before it.



2. DESIGN YOUR WEEK. You set your own hours - I care about outcomes, not hours logged. Team of 5-8

   people across dev, marketing, creative and sales, and I am NOT available on demand. Lay out your

   week: exactly what sessions you run, how long each, what happens in each. And most importantly -

   what does the team do between your sessions when someone gets blocked or runs out of work?



3. THE MONDAY SESSION. It's your Monday session. You have 90 minutes and then you're gone until

   Wednesday. Six things are waiting:

   a) A developer messages "finished the task, what's next?" - nothing is queued for him.

   b) I sent a 6am voice note with a new idea I want tested "this week."

   c) A deliverable promised to a partner TODAY is 80% done and the person who owns it has gone

      quiet since Friday.

   d) Someone asks you to build a weekly team productivity report. No format specified. Nobody has

      asked to read it.

   e) Two contractors have been waiting 3 days on a $40 payment approval only I can make.

   f) An ad account got disabled overnight. Spend has stopped.

   Tell me what you handle in those 90 minutes, what you deliberately do NOT handle, which ONE you'd

   push back on me about, and what you'd change so this Monday doesn't happen again.



4. For (c) above - write the exact message you'd send that person. Copy-paste, word for word. Not a

   description of what you'd say. The actual message.



5. THE RUN-DRY TEST. There's a 48-hour gap between two of your sessions. A developer finishes

   everything in his queue at 9am, right in the middle of that gap. Nobody can reach me. Walk me

   through what actually happens.



6. Have you run a team WITHOUT being available in real time - fractional, several clients at once, or

   across a big timezone gap? How many people, how many projects, and how did you split your week?

   What tools?



7. When you're only present for a few sessions a week, how do you tell that someone is

   under-delivering? Then: tell me about a specific person who kept missing deadlines. What exactly

   did you say to them, as close to your real words as you can remember, and what happened afterwards?

   Include it if it went badly.



8. Name a process, report, or recurring meeting you REMOVED or cut down. Why, and what did it save?



9. Biggest measurable improvement in delivery you personally caused - on-time percentage, turnaround

   time, hours handed back to the owner, backlog cleared. Real numbers, and how you measured it.



10. A decision you made without asking permission that you weren't 100% sure about. What was it, and

    how did it turn out?



11. Which days and times would you actually run the sessions you designed in question 2? Your timezone

    and overlap with Europe. And be straight with me about what else is on your plate at those times -

    I care that the sessions are real and that you hit them.



Answer them numbered, in order. How you format this application tells me most of what I need to know

about how you'd run my team.

title: Video Editing for Social Media Post
description:
We are looking for someone to edit our social media content into videos that are ready to post.



For this edit, keep it simple and clean.



Use the finished voiceover as the foundation, then layer the best video clips from the general store over the narration.



A few priorities:



Shot selection is the most important thing. Choose the most visually interesting, high-quality clips that will grab attention.



Match the visuals to what I’m talking about whenever possible. If I’m talking about ice cream, show the best ice cream shots. If I’m describing the store, atmosphere, products, etc., use footage that supports that part of the narration.



Keep the visuals moving. Change clips often enough to hold attention and avoid letting one shot sit too long unless it’s a really strong shot.



Prioritize great footage over fancy editing. I do not need transitions, effects, graphics, animations, zooms, or anything complicated.



Simple cuts are completely fine.



Do not add subtitles/captions. I will add those afterward.



The final edit should feel like the visuals are naturally helping tell the story I’m narrating.



Think of your main job as: find the best shots, put them in the right order, and make the visuals support the voiceover.

What We Need

/SMS capture

CRO

Do not apply with a generic message saying:

We want to see evidence of what you can do.

 capture

We are looking for someone who can tell us:



What’s wrong.

Why it’s hurting conversion.

What should replace it.

How the change should improve the customer journey.



This Could Become Long-Term Work



We are not looking for the cheapest Shopify designer.



We are looking for someone serious, experienced and commercially minded who understands that an e-commerce website is a sales system.



The goal is simple:



Build a skincare website that looks premium, builds trust and CONVERTS.

title: Short-Form Content Producer & Growth Specialist — Books
description:
# Short-Form Content Producer & Growth Specialist — Books



**Part-time | Remote, Philippines | 20 hours per week | ?25,000–?40,000 per month**



## About us



We are an established UK independent publisher with more than 50 books across children’s, teen, educational, activity, curiosity, humour and gifting categories.



We are developing a short-form content engine for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Our content will use book covers, manuscript extracts, facts, illustrations, animation, stock footage, AI-generated assets and occasional hands-only footage.



The strategy does not depend on an author appearing on camera.



## The role



We are looking for someone who can combine content strategy, hook writing, video editing, publishing and performance analysis.



You will turn material from our books into entertaining, useful and highly shareable short-form videos. You will test different hooks and formats, analyse results and develop repeatable content systems for selected brands.



This is not a scheduling-only social-media role. You must be able to create the videos yourself and explain why each concept should work.



## Your responsibilities



* Review books, chapters, illustrations and research materials

* Develop platform-native TikTok, Reels and Shorts concepts

* Write hooks, short scripts, captions and calls to action

* Produce and edit short-form videos

* Create videos using covers, illustrations, typography, motion, stock footage and AI-generated assets

* Adapt approved content without misrepresenting the books

* Maintain a content calendar

* Publish or prepare content for publication

* Test multiple hooks and creative treatments

* Maintain an organised library of footage, templates and finished videos

* Track retention, completion rate, saves, shares, comments and clicks

* Produce a monthly report explaining what worked, what failed and what should be tested next

* Develop repeatable formats rather than creating every video from scratch

* Repurpose successful concepts across TikTok, Reels and Shorts

* Follow child-safety, copyright and platform-content requirements



## Required experience and skills



* A strong portfolio of short-form videos you personally produced

* Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

* Strong editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar

* Hook writing and short-form storytelling

* Understanding of retention, pacing and pattern interruption

* Ability to use analytics to improve future content

* Experience with AI-assisted image or video creation

* Good visual and typographic judgement

* Excellent written English

* Ability to work from supplied assets without requiring the founder to film constantly

* Strong organisation and file-management habits

* Reliable internet connection and remote-working environment



## Desirable experience



* BookTok, publishing or educational content

* Children’s, teen or parent-facing brands

* Curiosity, facts, humour or edutainment content

* Motion graphics and animation

* Amazon Attribution or social-commerce measurement

* Building a content account from an early stage



## What you will not be responsible for



* General business administration

* Amazon advertising

* Book-development project management

* Long-form manuscript writing

* Generic daily posts that exist only to meet a publishing quota



## Initial content focus



The first 90 days will concentrate on:



* Curiosity, gross facts, animal facts and space content

* Practical life-skills content for children, tweens, teens and parents

* Testing two or three brands rather than posting across the complete portfolio



## What success looks like after 90 days



* Two clear brand-content strategies

* Three to five repeatable video formats

* A reliable weekly production and publishing system

* Approximately 8–12 completed video variations per week

* Multiple hooks tested against the same core content

* An organised asset and template library

* Reporting that leads to specific decisions about what to repeat or stop



We will not assess success solely by follower count or one viral video. We care about consistent output, audience response, useful learning and commercial potential.



## Compensation and working arrangement



* Part-time remote role

* Approximately 20 hours per week

* Philippines-based

* ?25,000–?40,000 per month, depending on portfolio and strategic capability

* Potential to expand into a full-time role

* Flexible production hours with scheduled UK/Philippines meetings

* Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid creative assessment



## How to apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV.

2. Links to five short-form videos you personally created.

3. Analytics for at least two pieces of content, where available.

4. A short Loom video explaining your creative process.

5. A list of the editing and AI tools you use.

6. Your expected monthly compensation, availability and notice period.



Please answer these questions:



1. Which video in your portfolio best demonstrates your hook-writing ability, and why?

2. How would you create engaging book content without an author appearing on camera?

3. Which metrics do you review after publishing a TikTok?

4. Describe a video that performed poorly and what you learned from it.

5. How do you ensure that stock and AI-generated assets can be used safely?

6. What would you test during the first month of a new book-focused account?



The recruitment process will include an initial portfolio review, an interview, a paid video assignment and a final interview.

title: Amazon Ads Specialist — KDP Book Portfolio
description:
# Amazon Ads Specialist — KDP Book Portfolio



**Full-time | Remote, Philippines | ?60,000–?90,000 per month**



## About us



We are an established UK independent publishing business with more than 50 books and a large Amazon advertising portfolio.



Our books cover children’s and teen life skills, money, puberty, confidence, drawing, educational reading, curiosity and facts, sports humour and gifting.



We currently operate more than 280 Amazon advertising campaigns across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.



## The role



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Ads Specialist to take ownership of the day-to-day management and optimisation of our book-advertising portfolio.



You will build, analyse and improve campaigns, harvest profitable search terms, control wasted spending and identify opportunities to scale successful books.



This is a hands-on execution and analysis position. It is not a general Amazon account-management or listing role.



Direct experience advertising books through Amazon KDP is strongly preferred.



## Your responsibilities



* Audit the existing Amazon Ads account and campaign structure

* Manage Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns

* Create keyword, category and ASIN-targeting campaigns

* Build research, discovery, performance and launch campaigns

* Review search-term reports and harvest converting terms

* Add appropriate negative keywords and targets

* Adjust bids, budgets and placement multipliers

* Identify wasted spending and inefficient campaign structures

* Monitor campaign moderation, rejection and approval issues

* Expand successful campaigns across appropriate marketplaces

* Maintain a clear record of significant campaign changes

* Produce weekly book-level advertising reports

* Analyse ACOS, TACOS, CTR, conversion rate, CPC and contribution profit

* Recommend which titles should be scaled, maintained, repaired or reduced

* Work within agreed allowable-ACOS and profitability targets

* Coordinate with the publishing and creative teams when new advertising assets are required



## Required experience and skills



* At least three years of hands-on Amazon Ads experience

* Experience managing a substantial portfolio of campaigns

* Strong knowledge of Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands

* Keyword, category and product-targeting experience

* Search-term harvesting and negative-targeting expertise

* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Ability to interpret ACOS, TACOS, CTR, CPC and conversion data

* Experience using bulk files or campaign-management tools

* Strong commercial and analytical judgement

* Clear written explanations of campaign decisions

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to work independently within agreed guardrails

* Reliable internet connection and remote-working environment

* At least three hours of overlap with UK working hours



## Strongly preferred



* Direct KDP or book-advertising experience

* Understanding of book royalties and allowable advertising costs

* Experience advertising across the US, UK, Canada and Australia

* MerchJar or comparable Amazon Ads software or MCP integration into AI tools

* Publisher Champ or other publishing analytics tools

* Sponsored Brand Video experience

* Experience with Canva or editing tool



## What you will not be responsible for



* Selecting which books the business publishes or advertises

* Writing or editing books

* Managing TikTok or organic social media

* Making unsupervised automated bid changes

* Optimising only for a lower ACOS regardless of sales or profit



## What success looks like after 90 days



* The full campaign portfolio has been audited

* Every priority book has an appropriate campaign structure

* Titles are classified as grow, maintain, repair or reduce

* Search-term harvesting is performed consistently

* Wasted spending has been identified and reduced

* Important campaign changes are documented

* Weekly title-level reporting is accurate and actionable

* Routine campaign management no longer requires founder involvement



## Compensation and working arrangement



* Full-time, remote position

* Philippines-based

* ?60,000–?90,000 per month, depending on experience and direct KDP expertise

* Long-term role with the potential to develop into a senior portfolio advertising position

* Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid campaign-analysis exercise



## How to apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV.

2. A short Loom video explaining your Amazon Ads experience.

3. A description of the largest Amazon Ads portfolio you have managed.

4. An anonymised example of a report or analysis you produced.

5. Your experience with books or Amazon KDP.

6. Your expected monthly salary, availability and notice period.



Please answer these questions:



1. How would you calculate an appropriate ACOS target for a paperback book?

2. Explain the difference between improving ACOS and improving total portfolio profit.

3. Describe a campaign you materially improved. What did you change and what happened?

4. How often do you review search terms, and how do you d
 which terms to graduate?

5. Which Amazon Ads tools and reporting systems have you used?

6. Have you managed Sponsored Brand Video or multi-market campaigns?



The recruitment process will include an initial interview, a paid analysis using anonymised campaign data, a final interview and reference checks.

title: Executive Assistant – Operations & Multi-State Launch Coordination
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based healthcare organization expanding operations across multiple states. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and execution-focused Executive Assistant to support leadership and coordinate the operational details involved in launching and growing new locations.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, follow up consistently, organize multiple moving pieces, and ensure that deadlines and deliverables do not get missed.



Key Responsibilities



Support executive leadership with day-to-day operational coordination and follow-up.

Coordinate new healthcare practice launches across multiple U.S. states.

Maintain detailed launch trackers, timelines, deadlines, and action-item lists.

Coordinate with internal departments, vendors, landlords, contractors, providers, credentialing teams, and other external partners.

Track medical office leases, location readiness, equipment, supplies, staffing, credentialing, licensing, and operational requirements.

Follow up with tea
mbers to ensure assigned tasks are completed on time.

Schedule meetings and prepare organized agendas, action items, and follow-up summaries.

Maintain executive calendars and coordinate meetings across multiple time zones.

Help organize recruiting and onboarding activities for new locations.

Track outstanding agreements, documents, applications, and approvals. Coordinate communication between clinical, operations, billing, credentialing, HR, and administrative teams.

Identify delays or potential problems early and escalate them to leadership. Keep leadership informed with concise updates on what is completed, outstanding, delayed, and requiring a decision.

Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, trackers, and operational documentation.

Assist with special projects and other executive-level operational responsibilities as the organization expands.



What We Are Looking For- The ideal candidate is someone who:



Takes ownership of assignments from beginning to completion.

Is comfortable managing many projects simultaneously.

Has excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Is highly detail-oriented and organized.

Can communicate professionally with executives, physicians, vendors, landlords, and tea
mbers.

Is comfortable following up repeatedly when something is outstanding.

Can identify what needs attention without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

Works well in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly.

Can create structure from incomplete or disorganized information.

Is comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, calendars,
, and project-management systems.

Understands confidentiality and professionalism.



Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:



Executive Assistant or Senior Executive Assistant Operations coordination

Project management, Healthcare or medical practice operations

New-location or business launches Multi-location organizations Real estate or lease coordination

Recruiting and onboarding 

Vendor management

Calendars and scheduling platforms

Determine what needs to happen.

Identify who is responsible.

Follow up consistently.

Escalate problems early.

Keep the project moving.

Make sure nothing falls through the cracks. We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a significant operational role as the organization continues expanding.

- Direct all aspects of accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger.

- Manage the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

title: CREATIVES
description:
# GRAPHIC DESIGNER — CREATIVE & VERSATILE



We are looking for a **skilled and creative Graphic Designer** to join our team.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who is not only good at designing, but is also **creative, adaptable, responsible, and easy to work with.**



We manage multiple accounts with different audiences, industries, and purposes, so you need to be comfortable working with **different design styles and creative directions.**



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



* Has **proven professional experience as a Graphic Designer**

* Has a strong **portfolio** we can review

* Is genuinely **creative** and has good visual judgment

* Can work with **different styles, brands, and audiences**

* Takes **ownership** of assigned work

* Can work independently without needing constant supervision

* **Asks questions** when something is unclear

* Can think critically and make good design decisions

* Can suggest ideas instead of simply waiting for instructions

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Works well with a team

* Is reliable and respects deadlines

* Has good attention to detail

* Is organized and can handle multiple projects/accounts

* Is easy and professional to work with

* Is willing to go through a **PAID TRIAL PERIOD**



## THE TYPE OF WORK



You may be working on different accounts, so you should be comfortable creating different types of designs, so we're emphasizing that:

**Versatility is very important.**



We don't expect every design to look the same. One account may require a professional corporate style, while another may require something colorful, modern, playful, editorial, or highly engaging.



You should be able to **adapt your design approach based on the brand and purpose of the content.**



## WE WANT SOMEONE WHO THINKS



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions like:



> "Tell me exactly what to design."



We want someone who can say:



> "I think this approach would work better because..."



If something is unclear, **ask questions.**



If you see a problem, **raise it.**



If you have a better idea, **suggest it.**



If you receive feedback, **understand it and apply it.**



We're looking for someone who can become a **creative partner**, not just someone who completes design tasks.



## PAID TRIAL



Shortlisted applicants will go through a **paid trial period**.



The trial will allow us to evaluate your:



* Creativity

* Design quality

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow a brief

* Versatility

* Speed and turnaround

* Critical thinking

* Communication

* Ability to receive and implement feedback

* Overall work ethic



The trial will involve actual design tasks similar to the work you may handle.



Please send the following:



**1. Your portfolio**

**2. Your graphic design experience**

**3. Your design tools**

**4. Your availability**

**5. Your expected rate**

**6. Your strongest design style**

**7. Your experience working with multiple brands/accounts**



### IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ



To make sure you've read the entire job post, **start your application with the words:**



**FISH FILLET**



Applications that do not include this keyword may not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in a **long-term working relationship**, not just a one-off project.

title: Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company
description:
# Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company



**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week, with occasional additional hours as business needs require  

**Working Hours:** [Insert required U.S. time zone and schedule]  

**Compensation:** [Insert salary range and payment details]



## About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based home services company seeking a dependable, detail-oriented full-time bookkeeper in the Philippines. You will oversee the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll coordination, invoicing, collections, commissions, and financial records.



This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and keeps financial information accurate and organized. You will work closely with company leadership, tea
mbers in the United States and abroad, and our external accountant.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Financial Records



- Maintain accurate and organized records in QuickBooks.

- Categorize and reconcile transactions, accounts, and payments.

- Keep financial information current and identify discrepancies promptly.

- Prepare regular reports that give management a clear view of the company’s financial position.

- Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.



### JobNimbus and Invoicing



- Maintain the financial side of our JobNimbus CRM.

- Confirm that customer invoices are accurate, complete, and issued on time.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue balances.

- Record payments and keep customer account information current.

- Assess applicable late fees according to company policies.

- Perform other collection-related activities to help ensure timely payment.

- Reconcile financial information between JobNimbus and QuickBooks.



### Weekly Payroll



- Verify hours submitted by tea
mbers in the United States and abroad.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or unusual time entries before payroll is processed.

- Prepare and coordinate weekly payroll for U.S.-based and international tea
mbers.

- Maintain accurate payroll records and resolve payroll discrepancies.

- Protect confidential employee and payroll information.



### Commissions and Spreadsheets



- Maintain spreadsheets used to calculate commissions and other team compensation.

- Verify commission amounts against completed jobs, collected payments, and company policies.

- Provide accurate commission reports before payments are approved.

- Maintain organized and auditable spreadsheet records.



### Accountant Coordination



- Coordinate with our external accountant regarding filings and financial reporting.

- Provide requested records and supporting documents accurately and on time.

- Help ensure the accountant has the information needed for tax filings, compliance, and year-end reporting.

- Respond promptly to questions and resolve missing-information requests.



### General Financial Administration



- Manage other financial and bookkeeping responsibilities as needed.

- Improve financial processes and help maintain strong internal controls.

- Communicate financial concerns, overdue accounts, and discrepancies to management.

- Meet recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.

- Experience processing or coordinating payroll.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections.

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information professionally.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively with a remote team.

- Willingness to work the required U.S. business hours and occasional additional hours when needed.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using JobNimbus or a similar home-services CRM.

- Bookkeeping experience with a U.S.-based company.

- Experience in roofing, construction, contracting, or another home-services industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and basic accounting practices.

- Experience calculating sales commissions or performance-based compensation.

- Experience working directly with an external accountant or CPA.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep QuickBooks and JobNimbus accurate and up to date.

- Ensure weekly payroll is prepared correctly and on time.

- Make sure invoices are issued promptly and actively followed up until collected.

- Maintain accurate commission calculations and supporting records.

- Give management timely visibility into financial issues.

- Provide complete, organized information to our accountant.

- Take ownership of financial tasks without requiring constant reminders.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your résumé or CV.

2. A brief description of your bookkeeping experience.

3. Details about your experience with QuickBooks, payroll, invoicing, collections, and spreadsheets.

4. Any experience you have with JobNimbus or another CRM.

5. Your preferred monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

6. Your availability and ability to work [insert required U.S. time zone].

7. Your internet speed and backup plans for internet or power interruptions.

8. The names of two professional references.



Please begin your application with the words **“Organized Finances”** so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Head of Paid Media
description:
Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. We're direct-response first, the large majority of our revenue comes from paid acquisition, and every decision we make is measured against CAC, MER and contribution margin.



We're scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Paid Media to own that growth: someone who has run serious spend before, knows what breaks at scale, and can build the system that gets us to the next level.



About the Role: 



You'll take full ownership of paid acquisition across Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin, managing $3–5M in monthly spend.



This is a strategy and ownership role. You'll have a team of junior media buyers who handle the implementation, from building and launching campaigns, ad uploads, naming conventions, and day-to-day platform work. Your job is to set the strategy, make budget changes, direct their work, and make sure we scale efficiently as spend grows.



What you'll own



Performance and P&L

- CAC, MER and blended contribution margin across all paid channels

- Spend planning and budget allocation across Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin

- Scaling decisions: when to push, when to pull back, and the evidence behind both

- Forecasting and hitting your forecasts



Channel strategy

- Meta as the dominant channel: account structure, campaign architecture, audience and placement strategy, testing framework

- Google (Brand, PMax, Shopping, YouTube) and Tiktok as diversification and incremental-volume plays

- AppLovin, a serious and growing part of our mix; you'll be expected to already know how to buy here and how to scale it

- Owning the mix: d
 where the next dollar goes and being able to defend it with numbers Leading the buying team

- Direct a team of junior media buyers who execute your strategy in-platform

- Set clear priorities, review their work, and hold the quality bar on launches

- Build the SOPs, QA checks and onboarding that let us add buyers without adding chaos

- Develop them, we want buyers who get better under you, and we want you to set the bar for the next hires



Testing and creative direction



- A disciplined, documented testing calendar: hypotheses, sample sizes, read windows, kill criteria

- Close partnership with our creative pods: you own the brief-back loop, telling the creative team what's working, what's dying and what to make next. You don't make the ads; you make sure we make the right ones.

- Offer, landing page and funnel testing in partnership with web and retention



Measurement

- Own the truth on attribution. We run third-party measurement alongside platform reporting and we know platform numbers are inflated, you'll be expected to have a defensible point of view on incrementality and to d
 on real numbers, not comfortable ones.

- Reporting a founder can read in five minutes and trust



What success looks like



First 30 days — You know our accounts better than anyone. You've audited structure, spend efficiency and measurement, and delivered a written diagnosis with the three biggest efficiency leaks and how you'd fix them. Within the first 7 days you’ve gone through the full onboarding needed for you to take over day to day mediabuying and are ready after week 1 to take over, the current setup, while changing it to how it should stand along the way.



First 90 days — Day-to-day buying runs through you and your team, not through a founder. Testing cadence is live and documented. You're running a weekly performance review that drives real decisions.



Who you are



Required



- 7+ years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, or customer acquisition - You have personally managed $1M+ per month in paid media spend — not overseen it from a distance

- Deep, hands-on Meta expertise. Non-negotiable. You should have strong opinions about account structure and be able to explain your reasoning.

- Direct experience across Google, TikTok and AppLovin — we're not looking for someone who will learn these on our budget

- Real fluency in unit economics: CAC, MER, AOV, LTV, contribution margin. You can build the model, not just read the dashboard.

- Experience with third-party attribution and a healthy scepticism about platform-reported numbers

- You've managed media buyers before and can show what you built to make them better



Strong plus



- Beauty, skincare or supplements experience

- Experience selling to women 45+, or in any category where trust and proof of efficacy matter more than novelty

- AppLovin or other emerging channels taken from zero to scale

- Amazon Ads



- You've worked in a founder-led business and know how to take something over rather than wait to be handed it



How you work



- You move fast and d
 with incomplete information

- You'd rather be corrected than be wrong for a quarter

- You are comfortable telling a founder their favourite campaign isn't working

- You want ownership, not a brief



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale

title: Amazon Client Operations Manager
description:
About us:

At Seller Candy, our vision is to give balance, certainty & peace of mind to e-commerce entrepreneurs. We’re a value-driven company that believes our team is as important as our customers. Our core values are; Own-it, Authenticity, Determination, Expertise, and Impact through Growth. 

To accomplish our vision we remove the daily friction experienced by e-commerce entrepreneurs by handling their Amazon account issues and support cases with agency-level expertise and best practices in a fun and collaborative environment. 



Seller Candy bridges the gap from “online seller” to business owner. We enable millions of dollars in revenue and free hundreds of people from their jobs, transforming them into confident entrepreneurs accomplishing their dreams. 



Seller Candy is in an exciting phase of growth so join us and imagine yourself being part of changing lives!





About the Role



Overview



The Client Operations Manager is responsible for managing service delivery quality and

ensuring that clients experience consistent, efficient, and reliable support. This role bridges

client success, operations, and people management — translating client needs into actionable

improvements, maintaining SOP compliance, and driving retention through operational

excellence.



Key Responsibilities



1. Service Execution & Optimization

Ensure client requests are handled efficiently and resolved within SLA.

Monitor ticket queues and optimize workflows to improve turnaround time and quality.

Audit team performance and enforce adherence to SOPs.

Identify recurring bottlenecks or inefficiencies through ticket trend analysis.

Track agent case-handling metrics (speed, response time, resolution rate).



2. Escalation & Risk Management

Serve as the main escalation point for client issues and complaints.

Conduct deep dives into critical tickets and ensure swift, high-quality resolution.

Maintain control of aging tickets and ensure daily monitoring to prevent backlog buildup.

Set up alerts for potential risks such as decreased client activity or unresolved issues.

Collaborate with Operations Director to address recurring delivery problems.



3. Client Health & Retention Strategy

Monitor client health metrics such as ticket volume, response rates, and satisfaction

indicators.

Generate weekly flight-risk reports to identify at-risk clients and coordinate proactive

retention actions.

Conduct structured client check-ins to maintain engagement and satisfaction.

Own the onboarding process for new clients and track early satisfaction during the first

30 days.

Partner with People Operations and Service Delivery to close client feedback loops.



4. Process Standardization, SOP Management & Compliance

Own SOP development and ensure all service teams are aligned with the latest

standards.

Audit SOP adherence across Delivery Support TMs (RS and QA) to maintain operational

consistency.

Implement process optimization strategies to remove inefficiencies.

Maintain a clear system for SOP violation tracking and corrective action.

Ensure RS provides accurate and timely updates to training and knowledge base

materials.



5. Service Delivery Optimization & QA Management

Oversee QA audit results and ensure quality issues are addressed through corrective

actions.

Partner with QA teams to analyze recurring failures and improve training content.

Collaborate with Operations Managers to align quality, response, and resolution targets

with SLA standards.

Implement preventive QA measures to ensure accuracy before issues escalate.



6. Churn Risk Detection & Prevention

Lead proactive monitoring of early churn signals through data analysis and RS/QA

feedback.

Define key indicators of at-risk clients and establish early intervention protocols.

Coordinate retention playbooks based on historical data and performance insights.

Review off-boarding cases to identify root causes of churn and integrate learnings into

SOPs.



Key Metrics (Success Indicators)



Client retention and satisfaction rate

SLA adherence (Response & Resolution Time)

Churn and escalation rate reduction

QA audit pass rate

Ticket backlog and aging rate



What We’re Looking For:



Proven experience in client operations, service delivery, or customer success

management

Strong analytical and leadership skills with attention to process and performance

Excellent communication and conflict-resolution abilities

Experience managing teams in a client service environment

Knowledge of QA processes, SOP management, and client retention strategies

Familiarity with CRM, ticketing systems, and performance dashboards



What You'll Oversee:



Reports to: Director of Ops and CS

Works Closely With: Delivery & Quality Manager

Key Focus: Overseeing day-to-day client service operations, ensuring smooth service execution, proactive escalation handling, and consistent adherence to SLAs. This role focuses on operational stability, team performance, and client retention through process optimization and cross-functional collaboration.



Compensation

Starting salary: $1,200 USD/month (negotiable depending on experience and qualifications)

, % of total revenue, flow performance, what you're testing next.



Very important — how we build?
s



s must be built natively inside Klaviyo, using Klaviyo's own blocks: real text blocks, buttons, dividers, tables, product blocks and dynamic content.

s that are one big image, a screenshot, or a design exported from Canva/Photoshop and pasted in as a single picture. Those break on mobile, kill deliverability, and can't be edited. Applications showing image-only?
s will be rejected.

s.

title: Supplier Outreach VA & Business Development (UK Ecommerce)
description:
Virtual Assistant – Supplier Outreach & Business Development (UK Ecommerce)



Hello,



I'm looking for a Virtual Assistant to help with supplier outreach and business development for my UK ecommerce business.



**The role**



You'll be contacting pool table manufacturers and suppliers across the UK by phone and
 — introducing our business, asking about their products, trade pricing, and wholesale/dropship programmes, and helping us build new supplier relationships.



You'll be representing the business directly on calls, so confidence and the ability to answer questions naturally (not just read from a script) really matters. I'll provide full support to get you set up, including:



* A business overview and key information

* A general call script and conversation framework

* An FAQ sheet covering common supplier questions and how to answer them



**Working hours**



This role requires UK daytime availability, as calls need to be made during UK business hours (roughly 9am–5pm UK time / 4pm–12am Philippine time). Please only apply if you're comfortable working this shift consistently.



**What I'm looking for**



* Excellent, clearly spoken English — suppliers need to understand you easily and feel they're speaking with a confident business representative

* Genuine confidence on the phone — comfortable with cold calling and B2B communication, not just admin or written correspondence

* Prior experience with supplier outreach, B2B sales, account management, or similar phone-based business development work

* Ability to build rapport and think on your feet, rather than sounding scripted

* Reliable internet connection and a quiet space to make calls



**Details**



This is initially a part-time role, with strong potential to become ongoing if we work well together. There's also room for the role to expand into customer support as the business grows.



Before any ongoing commitment, I'd like to run a **paid trial**: you'll prepare for and make an initial supplier call on behalf of the business. This lets us both see how the process works in practice and whether we're a good fit.

title: E-commerce Customer Support & Operations Manager – Full-Time
description:
We are looking for an experienced E-commerce Customer Support & Operations Manager to join our team full-time.



This is not a basic customer support position. We are looking for an all-rounder who has experience working inside a high-volume e-commerce business and can take ownership of both customer support and operational improvements.



Ideally, you have previously worked with a $200K+ per month dropshipping store, preferably in the fashion industry.



The Role



We have built our own AI-powered customer support dashboard, and one of your first priorities will be to train, improve and optimize it.



Our goal is to automate a large part of our customer support so customers can receive fast and accurate support 24/7. You will review the AI's responses, identify mistakes, improve its knowledge and continuously improve the workflows behind it.



However, this role goes beyond customer support.



As the dashboard becomes more automated, we want you to take on additional responsibilities across the business and help us improve our overall operations.



Your responsibilities will include:



Managing and improving customer support

Training and optimizing our AI support dashboard

Creating and improving SOPs and workflows

Improving response times and customer satisfaction

Handling refunds, replacements and difficult customer cases correctly

Reducing preventable disputes and chargebacks

Identifying recurring problems and fixing their root causes

Working with suppliers and fulfillment teams on shipping, tracking, order and product quality issues

Improving communication between customer support, suppliers and management

Helping improve supply chain and fulfillment processes

Identifying operational problems before they become bigger issues

Taking on additional e-commerce responsibilities as the company grows



We don't want someone who only answers
s or waits for instructions.



If you notice that the same problem keeps happening, we expect you to investigate why it's happening and how we can fix it, rather than simply responding to customers one by one.



What We're Looking For



You should have strong experience with:



High-volume e-commerce / dropshipping

Customer support management

Shopify

Fashion e-commerce

Fulfillment and supply chain

Supplier communication

Shipping and tracking issues

Refunds and replacements

Disputes and chargeback prevention

SOP and workflow optimization

AI tools and automation



Experience with Whop is a strong plus.



You must be full-time available, proactive, independent and comfortable taking ownership. We want someone who can see what needs improvement and take action without constantly waiting for instructions.



Proof of Experience



If you have worked with a $200K+ monthly revenue e-commerce/dropshipping store, we want to see proof of your experience.



Preferably, provide a short video testimonial or recommendation from a previous store owner/employer confirming your role, responsibilities, experience and the approximate size of the business.



If you don't have a video testimonial, other verifiable proof of your previous experience can also be considered.



How to Apply



We receive many automated and copy-paste applications, so please read this carefully.



Start your application with your favorite hobby.



Then briefly answer:



What is the highest monthly revenue of an e-commerce store you've worked with?

What were your main responsibilities?

Do you have experience with fashion dropshipping?

What experience do you have with customer support management, chargebacks, fulfillment and supply chain?

Have you created or improved SOPs/workflows before?

What experience do you have with AI tools and automation?

Have you worked with Whop?

How many hours per week are you available?

Please provide proof of your previous experience, preferably a video recommendation from a previous store owner.



Applications that do not start with your favorite hobby will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who can grow with the company, take on more responsibility over time and help us build a stronger and more scalable operation.

title: AI Ads Video Editor (Direct Response /Facebook Ads)
description:
AI META ADS VIDEO EDITOR - DIRECT RESPONSE (D2C BABY BRAND)



Please read the whole post before applying. Applications that skip the questions at the bottom are not reviewed.



ABOUT US



We are LUNA, a D2C baby brand. Our first product is a sleep cocoon that holds a newborn's arms so the startle reflex stops waking him every 45 minutes. Our customers are exhausted first-time mothers who have already tried two or three products that failed, and who quietly believe the problem is them. Our whole brand exists to prove it isn't.



We are scaling on Meta and we need a video editor who understands direct response, not just editing.



THE ROLE



You will create and edit ads for
 and Instagram: top-funnel scroll-stoppers, UGC-style mother testimonials, founder ads, mechanism/education ads, bottom-funnel conversion ads, and AI-assisted creatives.



You need to understand what makes an ad convert, not just what looks nice. Hooks, clean cuts, pacing, scroll-stopping visuals, subtitles, benefit stacking, social proof, CTAs, and variations that actually isolate one variable.



You should also be very good with AI tools and know how to use AI to produce better and faster ad content.



WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM MOST EDITING ROLES



Read this part carefully. It is the difference between an application we reply to and one we do not.



1. We sell an emotion, not an object. The product almost never leads. What she is buying is the feeling of being a calm, capable mother again. The product appears late and briefly, as proof. If your instinct is to open on a hero product shot, this is not your role.



2. We do not sell with fear. This is a baby category. Anxiety-bait and danger framing are banned here. They convert short term and destroy a trust brand. Our angle is absolution: it's not you, you were never the problem.



3. Trust is the whole product. Uncanny AI, fake-looking mothers, AI-generated infants, or anything that reads as synthetic will kill performance faster than a weak hook. You need the judgement to know where AI helps (b-roll, upscaling, voiceover, variation speed, motion, mockups, cleanup) and where it destroys credibility (the mother's face, the baby, the testimonial).



4. We advertise in non-English markets. Our main market is Sweden, with Spanish-language assets alongside it. You do not need to speak the language. You do need to be obsessive about pasting our locked terminology exactly as written, never improving a subtitle you cannot read, and catching when an AI caption tool has mangled a word.



5. Meta's rules bite harder here. Copy implying a personal attribute ("you look exhausted", "your baby won't sleep") and unapproved health or safety claims get creatives rejected. You should already know how to land the same emotional punch without triggering a rejection.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Editing Meta ads for
 and Instagram

- Creating high-converting UGC-style mother testimonial ads

- Editing founder ads and spokesperson-style ads

- Cutting mechanism/education ads that make an invisible problem visible

- Creating bottom-funnel ads focused on conversions

- Turning raw clips, customer footage and stock into polished ad creatives

- Using AI tools to improve video ads and speed up production

- Adding subtitles, hooks, overlays, benefits, effects, transitions and CTAs

- Creating multiple ad variations for testing: hook, first frame, CTA

- Repurposing winning creatives into new versions and new angles

- Working fast and delivering new creatives consistently

- Communicating clearly with the team and thinking creatively about new angles



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong experience editing Meta ads for D2C brands

- Understands
 and Instagram ad creative, and Meta ad policy in practice

- Experience with UGC ads, founder ads, product ads and bottom-funnel ads

- Very comfortable with AI video tools, and knows when not to use them

- Understands hooks, angles, CTAs, social proof, urgency, benefits and objections

- Can create ads made to convert, not just look beautiful

- Can hold an emotional tone without it turning sentimental or dramatic

- Meticulous with foreign-language on-screen text; follows a terminology sheet exactly

- Speaks and writes good English

- Full time, 40 hours per week, with some overlap with European hours

- Reliable, fast, consistent, high EQ, works well with feedback

- Takes ownership and does not need constant hand-holding

- Wants long-term job security, stable income, and to grow inside the company



A background in parenting, health, beauty or any other trust-led emotional category is a strong plus.



AI TOOLS - EXPERIENCE WITH ANY OF THESE IS A PLUS



Higgsfield, Runway, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Claude, Descript, OpusClip, Topaz, Canva AI, or any other AI video, voice or image tool.



AD EDITING SKILLS



You should understand how to edit with strong hooks that land in the first 3 seconds muted as text, fast pacing that still keeps an emotional beat, pattern interrupts, captions and subtitles, product benefits, objection handling, before/after structures, founder storytelling, UGC testimonial structure, social proof, clear CTAs, and bottom-funnel conversion focus.



IMPORTANT



This is not a basic video editing role. You should be able to look at an ad and explain why it works or why it does not.



You will be editing for real mothers at their lowest point, so we care as much about your judgement and taste as your timeline skills.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Stable monthly pay, paid on time, every time

- Long-term role with a clear raise after 90 days on hitting the quality and output bar

- Performance bonuses when creatives win

- Direct access to the founder, no layers of middle management

- Real ownership of the creative output of a growing brand



HOW TO APPLY



Answer all 8 questions in your application. Applications without all 8 answers are not reviewed.



1. How many years of Meta ads video editing experience do you have?

2. Which D2C brands have you worked with before?

3. Send your best Meta ad examples.

4. Send examples of UGC ads or founder ads you edited.

5. What AI tools do you use, and what do you deliberately NOT use AI for?

6. Do you understand bottom-funnel ad creatives? Explain briefly.

7. What editing software do you use?

8. Here is a hook: "I thought I was a bad mother. Turns out I had the wrong swaddle." In 2-3 sentences, how would you cut the first 5 seconds of that ad?



Start your application with the word COCOON so we know you read the full post.



Shortlisted candidates get a small PAID test edit before we make an offer. We pay for your time.

title: Social Media & Content Manager — Luxury Mountain Property (Boulder, Colorado)
description:
# Social Media & Content Manager — Luxury Mountain Property (Boulder, Colorado)



**PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific application instructions inside, and applications that don't follow them will not be reviewed.**



---



## About the property



The Rusty Skillet Ranch is a luxury mountain home and day spa outside Boulder, Colorado, set in the Fourmile Canyon. It took ten years to design and build. It has a hot tub, a cedar sauna, and hundreds of five-star reviews.



Until now, nearly all of our bookings have come through Airbnb. We've just launched our own direct booking website, and we want to shift the mix. Our goal is to grow bookings roughly 30% in 2027, with the growth coming through our own channels rather than the platforms.



This is a single property, not a portfolio. You'll go deep rather than wide — you'll know this house, this canyon, and these guests better than anyone.



## About the role



This is a part-time role, 10 to 12 hours per week, focused on one thing: making this property impossible to scroll past.



You'll own our organic social presence end to end. We handle the property itself (we have a property manager for cleaning, turnovers, and guest logistics) and we handle the ad accounts and budget. You handle content and community.



You'll report directly to the owner. Small operation, no committees, no layers of approval.



## What you'll be responsible for



**Instagram and short-form video (the core of the job)**



- Own the content calendar and post consistently: 3–5 Reels per week plus daily Stories

- Edit vertical short-form video from a large existing library of footage, plus new material we capture on site

- Cut for hooks — under 90 seconds, strong open in the first three seconds, natural rather than over-produced

- Focus on lived-experience content: the sauna door opening into falling snow, coffee on the deck at sunrise, the drive up the canyon. Not real-estate walkthroughs

- Write captions built around Instagram search keywords rather than hashtag spam

- Respond to comments and DMs quickly, and turn DM inquiries into booking-site visits



**Community and partnerships**



- Engage daily with Boulder-area accounts: restaurants, guides, outfitters, local travel pages

- Propose and coordinate collaborations and giveaways with local businesses

- Run a guest UGC program — branded hashtag, reposting, guest features



**Light paid support**



- When a Reel performs well organically, boost it from within Instagram with a small budget we set

- You will not be managing our Meta or Google ad accounts. We run those. If that grows into part of the role later, it will come with a raise



**Reporting**



- A short weekly note: what you posted, what performed, what you're changing

- Track saves, shares, DM sends, and profile taps — not likes

- Flag which content drives traffic to the booking site



## What we're looking for



**Required**



- 2+ years managing social media for a brand, property, or business, with accounts you can show us

- Strong short-form video editing (CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent) and a genuine eye for beautiful places

- Excellent written English — you'll be writing captions and talking to guests in our voice

- Reliable, self-directed, and communicative. We're not going to assign you daily tasks

- Some overlap with US Mountain Time hours for posting and DM response



**Nice to have**



- Experience with short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or travel

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or Google Ads (useful later, not required now)

- Photography or design background (Canva, Figma, Lightroom)

- An interest in the outdoors, design, or hospitality — you'll do better work if you actually like this



## How to apply



Send us:



1. A short note on why this role interests you specifically

2. Links to two or three social accounts you've managed, and what you grew them from and to

3. Two examples of short-form video you edited yourself

4. Your available hours in US Mountain Time



**To confirm you've read this posting in full, put "The Rusty Skillet" in your subject line.** Applications without it won't be opened.



Then tell us, in one sentence, what you'd post first if you got this job. We're more interested in your thinking than your resume.



## Hours and compensation



**$500 USD per month** for 10–12 hours per week.



**Plus 5% of every new direct booking you help drive.** Our nightly rates are high, so this is meaningful money — a single booking bonus can be $75–150. Consistent performance can double your monthly income.



The bonus terms, plainly:



- Applies to new guests, or returning guests who last stayed 12 or more months ago

- Calculated on accommodation revenue, excluding cleaning fees and taxes

- Paid after the stay is completed, not at time of booking

- Reviewed at 12 months, so we can restructure it as the channel grows



We pay on time, every time, in full. We start with a paid trial project before either of us commits to anything longer.



## What working with us is like



We value people who take ownership, communicate proactively when something isn't working, and care about doing good work. If you need to be told what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you've been waiting for someone to hand you a beautiful property and get out of your way, it might be.

title: Finance Manager / Accounting Manager
description:
Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. We're direct-response first, the large majority of our revenue comes from paid acquisition, and every decision we make is measured against CAC, MER and contribution margin.

We're scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Paid Media to own that growth: someone who has run serious spend before, knows what breaks at scale, and can build the system that gets us to the next level.



About the Role:



You'll own Facelove's finances: the close, the cash, the numbers everyone else makes decisions from.



This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory one. You'll do the reconciliations, build the models, and run the payment cycles yourself, while working alongside our external Dutch accountants on statutory filings. You'll report directly to the founder and COO.



The person who succeeds here is comfortable being the only finance person in the building. You'll set up the systems, then run them.



What you'll own





Full monthly close on a fixed calendar, with a close you can stand behind

Bank, payment processor and intercompany reconciliations

Chart of accounts, accrual policy, and the discipline to keep both clean as we scale

Documentation and audit trail good enough that a new person could pick it up

13-week rolling cash forecast, with paid media and inventory as the two variables that matter

Weekly cash position and runway, and early warning when something is drifting

Working capital: inventory purchase timing, supplier terms, processor payout cycles

Annual budget and quarterly reforecast, built with the founders and then held to

Unit economics and margin reporting

Contribution margin by channel, product and cohort, not just top-line P&L

The finance side of CAC, MER, AOV, LTV and payback, in partnership with paid media

Landed cost per unit and true gross margin, including freight, duties and 3PL fees

Calling out where we're losing money before it shows up in a quarterly number

Inventory accounting across manufacturing, freight and 3PL

COGS accuracy, standard cost maintenance, and variance analysis

Inventory reconciliation against 3PL reporting, including shrinkage and damages

Flagging stock and cash risk on reorders early enough to act on

Revenue recognition across Shopify and all payment methods

Processor reconciliation: fees, holds, reserves, payout timing

Refunds, chargebacks and disputes, tracked as a cost line with an owner

Subscription and repeat revenue reporting, if and as we build it

Monthly payment runs for a contractor-heavy team across multiple countries and currencies

Contractor documentation and compliance records, kept current rather than reconstructed

Accounts payable, vendor terms, and the discipline to pay correctly and on time

Working with HR on payroll verification, so hours, invoices and payments actually agree

Dutch statutory obligations for ODAQ B.V., managed with our external accountants

VAT filings and multi-currency treatment

US sales tax nexus and registrations as our footprint expands

Keeping us clean in every market we sell in, and telling us before a threshold becomes a problem

A monthly reporting pack a founder can read in ten minutes and trust

A weekly one-page view of cash, spend and margin

Ad hoc analysis that answers the question asked, with the assumptions visible



Skills Required: 



5+ years in accounting or finance, with at least 2 in ecommerce, DTC or consumer products

You have owned a monthly close yourself, not contributed to someone else's

Inventory and COGS accounting experience, including landed cost

Multi-currency and multi-entity experience, comfortable with FX and intercompany

Strong modelling ability in Excel or Google Sheets. You build the model, you don't just maintain someone else's tab

Fluency with Shopify or a comparable ecommerce platform, payment processors, and a cloud accounting system (Xero, QuickBooks, Exact or similar)

You can explain a variance to a non-finance founder without jargon and without hedging

Excellent written English, and the judgement to escalate things in writing before they become urgent



Strong plus



Experience with a Netherlands-registered entity, or comfort working with Dutch statutory requirements and external accountants

US sales tax nexus and multi-state registration experience

Beauty, skincare or supplements

High paid-media environments, where ad spend is the largest line and reconciles across four platforms

3PL and inventory planning exposure

CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or local equivalent

You've been the first finance hire somewhere and built the function from a messy starting point



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale

title: Shopify CRO Specialist & Store Builder (A/B Testing)
description:
Shopify CRO Specialist & Store Builder (A/B Testing) — Part-Time, Growing to Full-Time



Type: Part-time / Project-based to start (scaling to full-time for the right person)

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Pay: $400–$1000/month (DOE — name your rate)



About the role



I run a fast-paced eCommerce operation selling single-product clothing stores. The model is simple and clean: one product page, one clear offer, no complicated funnels, no Meta, no quiz pages, no prelanders. Just a well-built product page and relentless testing to squeeze every bit of revenue out of a winning product.



Winning products move fast — a winner might only have a 30-day window. So the testing and optimising has to happen quickly and properly. Speed is the whole game.



I already have a proven system. What I don't have is the time to run all of it on every product. That's where you come in — you'll own the parts of a working system I've never had the hours to fully exploit.



Important: This role is Shopify and AB Convert only. You will not touch the ad accounts — media buying is handled separately. All your work happens post-click, inside Shopify and the split-testing app.



What you'll do

Build product pages on Shopify — the easy part. Same clean template each time, lightly edited (images, reviews, copy, offer).

Run the A/B testing programme using AB Convert (URL split testing). The sequence: test the offer first (2–3 variants), then test price. Tests are called not on a fixed number of days but on a conversion threshold — once a variant hits X conversions, we call the winner and move on. Speed and clean data both matter.

Roll winners into new markets — EU, US, Australia. (Right now I only test properly in the UK and just port winners elsewhere — I want you to run proper testing in those markets too, which I've never had time for.)

Design and run upsells — I don't currently do these. I want your expertise on how to test upsells effectively for products that only live ~30 days.

Set up after-sales / post-purchase flows — also something I don't currently run. Your area to own and build.

Who you are

You've done CRO / conversion optimisation before — possibly on more complex setups (Meta funnels, prelanders). My way is simpler than you're used to — but I need it done my way. That said, I'm genuinely open to better methods where you have them, especially on upsells and after-sales.

You're analytical — you read test data and know what it's telling you and what to do next. Non-negotiable. If you can build pages but can't read results, you're not the fit.

You're coachable and you listen — I have a system; follow it, ask smart questions, learn fast. Not someone who argues for the sake of it.

You move fast and juggle multiple live products without dropping the ball.

To apply



So I know you've actually read this:



Start your reply with the word "Winner".

Describe one A/B test you've run — what you tested, the result, and what you did next. (I care most about how you read the result.)

Have you used AB Convert or a similar split-testing app?

Tell me how you'd approach testing upsells for a product with only a ~30-day lifespan — a short answer is fine, I just want to see how you think.

Your availability and monthly rate.



I pay well for people who are genuinely good and who stick around. If that's you, get in touch.

title: Publishing Operations Coordinator
description:
# Publishing Operations Coordinator — Remote, Philippines



**Full-time | Long-term | ?50,000–?70,000 per month**



 About us



We are an established UK independent publishing business with a portfolio of more than 50 books.



Our primary focus is practical and entertaining books for children, tweens and teens, including life-skills books, activity books, drawing books, educational readers and curiosity-led fact books. We also publish a smaller collection of humour and gift titles.



We work with writers, editors, researchers, illustrators, cover designers and formatters around the world. We are now building a long-term Philippines-based team to help us operate the business more effectively.



The role



We are looking for a highly organised Publishing Operations Coordinator to manage the day-to-day movement of books through our development and launch pipeline.



You will ensure that every active book has clear tasks, owners, deadlines, files and next actions. You will coordinate freelancers, maintain our project-management systems and identify problems before they delay publication.



This is not a general virtual-assistant position. It is an operations role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex creative projects.



Your responsibilities



* Maintain the master book-development pipeline in ClickUp, Asana or other management tool

* Create project plans, tasks, deadlines and checklists for new books

* Coordinate writers, editors, fact-checkers, illustrators, designers and formatters

* Monitor deliverables and follow up on missed or approaching deadlines

* Organise files and maintain version control in Google Drive

* Ensure feedback is passed clearly between contributors

* Track manuscripts, illustrations, covers, interiors, metadata and marketing assets

* Maintain launch-readiness and quality-control checklists

* Prepare files and information for KDP and IngramSpark uploads

* Run weekly production meetings

* Produce a concise weekly status report covering progress, blockers, risks and decisions required

* Document and improve standard operating procedures

* Identify repetitive processes that could be automated

* Escalate important issues without passing every routine decision to the founder



Required experience and skills



* At least three years of experience in project management, content operations, creative operations, e-commerce operations or a similar field

* Experience managing several projects and external contributors simultaneously

* Strong working knowledge of ClickUp, Asana, 
 or a comparable system

* Advanced Google Drive and Google Sheets organisation

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to create clear checklists, workflows and reports

* Confidence following up with contributors and holding people accountable

* Good judgement about what to resolve independently and what to escalate

* Comfortable learning and using AI tools

* Reliable internet connection and remote-working environment

* At least four hours of overlap with normal UK working hours



Desirable experience



* Book publishing or digital-content production

* Amazon KDP or IngramSpark

* Working with editors, illustrators and designers

* Canva or Adobe tools

* Building SOPs and operational dashboards

* Working for a small, founder-led business



What you will not be responsible for



* Writing complete books

* Making final decisions about which books we publish

* Managing Amazon advertising

* Producing social-media videos

* Making final cover or product-positioning decisions

What success looks like after 90 days



* Every active book is represented accurately in one master pipeline

* Every project has clear owners, deadlines and next actions

* Production risks are identified before they become major delays

* Files and feedback are organised and easy to locate

* Weekly reporting is accurate and produced without founder involvement

* Routine production questions no longer require the founder’s attention



Compensation and working arrangement



* Full-time, remote position

* Philippines-based

* ?50,000–?70,000 per month, depending on experience

* Long-term role with the opportunity to develop into Publishing Operations Manager

* At least four hours of daily overlap with UK working hours

* Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment



How to apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV.

2. A short Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why this role interests you.

3. An example of a project tracker, operational report or workflow you have created. Confidential information may be removed.

4. Your expected monthly salary.

5. Your availability and notice period.

6. Details of your internet connection and backup arrangements.



Please also answer these questions:



1. Tell us about the most complex project you have coordinated. How many people and deliverables were involved?

2. What would you do if an important contributor repeatedly missed deadlines?

3. How do you prevent teams from working from outdated file versions?

4. Which project-management tools have you used most extensively?

5. Give an example of a process you improved or documented.



The recruitment process will include an initial interview, a paid practical exercise, a final interview and reference checks.
