title: Ecommerce Video Editor (VSLS/SHORT FORM)
description:
# Expert eCommerce Direct-Response Video Editor — Meta Ads



**Remote | Full-Time or Contract**



We are a rapidly scaling eCommerce brand seeking an expert-level **Direct-Response Video Editor** to create high-converting Meta ad creatives.



This role is specifically for editors who specialize in **eCommerce VSLs and paid social advertising**. If direct-response eCommerce editing is not a core part of your daily work, this position will not be the right fit.



## Role Overview



Your primary responsibility will be editing **2–5 minute VSL-style Meta ads designed to generate purchases**.



You will also create short-form ad formats, including:



* Claymation-style creatives

* Pixar-style creatives

* Skeleton and anatomy-based creatives

* AI-generated UGC

* Product demonstrations

* Other emerging direct-response formats



Our goal is not simply to create visually appealing videos. Every creative must be built to capture attention, maintain retention, communicate value, and drive conversions.



## Direct-Response Structure



You should be experienced in editing ads built around frameworks such as:



* Problem

* Agitation

* Authority

* Discovery

* Unique mechanism

* Product introduction

* Benefits

* Social proof

* Testimonials

* Offer

* Scarcity

* Call to action



You must understand how to visually reinforce every line of a script and maintain viewer attention throughout the entire advertisement.



## Creative Style



Our preferred editing style includes:



* Documentary-style visuals

* Limited reliance on generic stock footage

* AI-generated B-roll

* AI-generated UGC

* 3D product and mechanism animations

* Dynamic captions

* Motion graphics

* Split-screen layouts

* Callouts and annotations

* Red circles, arrows, and visual emphasis

* Product proof and demonstration elements

* Fast-paced editing

* Frequent pattern interrupts

* Strategic sound design and visual effects



Problem-focused sections should feel emotional, tense, frustrating, and relatable.



Benefit-focused sections should feel aspirational, positive, hopeful, and transformational.



## AI Content Generation



You will be expected to create and incorporate AI-generated assets using tools such as:



* Freepik

* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* Kling

* Similar AI video and image-generation platforms



You should be comfortable producing:



* AI actors

* AI-generated UGC

* AI B-roll

* AI environments

* AI product demonstrations

* Product mechanism visuals

* 3D visual explanations

* Custom scenes based on script requirements



Strong prompting skills and the ability to generate consistent, realistic assets are required.



## Responsibilities



* Edit 2–5 minute direct-response VSLs for Meta advertising

* Create multiple hook and creative variations from winning concepts

* Produce one complete VSL package per day

* Generate AI visuals and supporting assets when necessary

* Incorporate existing brand footage, product imagery, testimonials, and creative assets

* Add captions, motion graphics, sound design, visual effects, and pattern interrupts

* Rapidly implement feedback and creative revisions

* Deliver high-quality creatives consistently and on schedule

* Help improve hooks, watch time, retention, click-through rates, and conversion rates

* Maintain organized project files and creative versions



## Required Experience



You must have extensive experience with:



* eCommerce VSL editing

* Meta and
 advertising

* Direct-response marketing

* Hook development

* Retention-focused editing

* Visual storytelling

* CTA placement

* Conversion-focused creative strategy

* AI-generated content

* High-volume creative production



You must be capable of producing creatives quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality.



## Production Expectations



For short-form content, the expected output is:



* **Four 60-second videos per day**



For VSL content, the expected output is:



* **One 3–4 minute VSL per day**

* Each VSL package should include:



  * One main body

  * Five hook variations



You must be able to meet daily deadlines and maintain consistent communication.



## Portfolio Requirements



To be considered, you must submit:



* Your portfolio

* Multiple eCommerce VSLs that you personally edited

* Examples of creatives used for Meta advertising

* Examples featuring AI-generated content

* A list of the AI tools you use

* Your typical turnaround time for a 3-5 minute VSL

* Your availability for an interview in Eastern Time



Applications without relevant eCommerce direct-response examples will not be considered.



At the very bottom of your application, include the word:



**apple**

title: Sales Operations Administrator
description:
Welcome to MEGHANI, an independent timepiece company that believes in the power of time. MEGHANI is dedicated to surveying the relativity of individual and collective relationships within time and memory. Our commitment to exceptional design and storytelling is guided by this fundamental principle.



The purpose of what we create is rooted in a deep history of timekeeping; Now run by the third generation of family members, sibling duo Amir and Shabeena Meghani — MEGHANI is made up of a tight knit team of individuals who run our two in-house timepiece brands: BREDA & JBW. Welcome to our world.



The Sales Operations Administrator at MEGHANI is a full-time, hourly position reporting to the Wholesale Director. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our product catalog, pricing, and promotional content are accurate, up to date, and optimized for both internal teams and retail partners. You will work cross functionally with Merchandising, Product, Marketing, and Retail teams to streamline operational processes and maintain high quality digital and inventory data.



What You’ll Do



Product Launch & Templates

- Create and maintain product launch templates to ensure consistent data, imagery, and promotional information

- Coordinate with cross functional teams to collect necessary assets and information for new product launches.



Catalog & Inventory Management

- Conduct regular product audits to ensure inventory and product information is accurate and live.

- Update pricing and promotional details in systems and maintain accuracy across digital and retail channels

- Monitor inventory liveness to prevent stock discrepancies or issues affecting product availability



Digital Asset & Data Management

- Manage product imagery across platforms, ensuring correct specifications and organization.

- Maintain Drive and Dropbox folders, keeping all product and marketing assets well structured and up to date.

- Update and maintain retailer, internal, and vendor contact lists for accurate communication and outreach.



Process Improvement & Collaboration

- Identify inefficiencies in current product operations workflows and propose solutions.

- Partner with Marketing, Retail, and Product teams to implement best practices for product data and asset management.

- Support reporting and ad hoc requests related to product operations and inventory.



What You’ll Bring

- 2+ years of experience in product operations, merchandising, retail operations, or e-commerce support.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable managing multiple digital tools, cloud storage systems, and spreadsheets.

- Proficiency in Excel – Strong expertise required. Candidate must be highly skilled with advanced functions including VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, PivotTables, and related tools.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally.

- Proactive and solutions oriented with a focus on maintaining accurate, timely product data.

title: AI CONTENT CREATOR & SOCIAL MEDIA SPECIALIST
Digital Marketing Account Manager
description:
Location: Remote

Pay: Starting at $8 (Can get to $25 with experience and tenure) - Initially starting as Part-time, can move up to Full-time.

Reports to: Director of Operations

Works with: Strategists, Project Managers, Creative and Technical Teams



We’re not looking for someone to babysit accounts. We’re looking for someone who leads them. 



You understand how digital marketing works and you know how to earn trust fast. You’re calm under pressure, firm when it counts, and confident enough to call things out when they’re off. 



You care about doing right by the client and protecting the team that delivers.

This is not a “yes man” position. It’s a leadership role inside the client relationship. You speak up when something needs attention, and you keep both sides aligned. You know how to guide a conversation with confidence and keep everyone focused on results.



This role exists so leadership can focus on growth, the team can focus on great work, and clients can feel confident they’re in good hands.



Pay is reflected based on experience and training requirements. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Lead Clients with Confidence

Be the main point of contact for your clients. You set the tone. Keep communication simple, direct, and proactive. Know what the client actually wants and make sure that’s what is happening. Push back when needed and protect the integrity of the work. Keep clients updated on progress, wins, and next steps before they have to ask.



- Own the Account

Take full responsibility for the health and success of each account. Review what’s being done before it reaches the client. Make sure work aligns with the strategy, scope, and client expectations. Catch problems early and get them fixed fast. Escalate the right things to leadership with clear context and solutions.



- Keep the Team Aligned

Work with project managers to keep timelines, deliverables, and sprints on track. Keep strategists informed without pulling them into every conversation. Help the team understand the client’s goals and what success actually means. Make sure everyone knows what’s been promised, what’s next, and what done/approval looks like.



- Support Growth and Retention

Spot opportunities that make sense for the client and the business. Join renewal and expansion conversations when needed. Keep strong client relationships that lead to retention and referrals. Track results and tell the story of progress in a way clients understand.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

Clients trust the process and know they’re in good hands. Strategists and project managers can stay focused on their lanes and perform better. Red flags are handled early. Problems don’t surprise anyone. Communication is clear, calm, and consistent. Accounts stay healthy, clients stay longer, and the team runs smoother.



WHO YOU ARE:

You’ve managed digital marketing clients before and understand how agencies operate. You understand web design, development, CRO, SEO, and paid media enough to know what good looks like. You’re comfortable having hard conversations and holding people accountable. You stay organized even when things get messy. You take initiative and move things forward without being told. You communicate clearly and directly in writing and on calls. You care about results and the people who make them happen. You think fast, but you don’t rush. You keep things steady when others get flustered.



PAY AND GROWTH:

Starting at $8 (Can get to $25 with experience and tenure) - Initially starting as Part-time

Commission on new business or expansions you help close in the first year (5 to 10 percent)

Ongoing commission on retained accounts (1 to 3 percent)

Growth path toward Senior Account Manager or Client Strategist



HOW THIS ROLE FITS:

Reports to the Director of Operations. Partners with the Strategist to ensure the vision is executed right. Works with Project Managers to keep delivery on track. Protects the relationship between the client and the team.



ENERGY AND CULTURE:

We move fast. We stay organized. We keep promises. We lead with integrity and own our results. If you want to work with a team that values clarity, accountability, and real impact, you’ll fit in here.



HOW TO APPLY:

- Reply to this job ad here on Online Jobs PH ONLY

- Your resume as a PDF (Google drive link)

- A short cover letter that explains why this role fits you now

- Answers to the questions below in a separate PDF (Google drive link)



QUESTIONS:

1. Tell us about a time you had to push back on a client or tea
mber to protect the integrity of a project. What happened and how did you handle it?



2. When managing multiple clients, how do you keep track of what is happening across each account and spot potential issues before they become problems?



3. Describe a time when you had to get a project or client relationship back on track after something went wrong. What did you do to rebuild trust and 
ntum?



RECENT WORK AND BACKGROUND:

1. What have you been working on for the past three months. Share the types of clients or projects you managed and your day to day responsibilities



2. Have you worked with any US based agencies or clients before. If so, please share two or three references we can contact, with names and
 addresses.

title: Senior Performance Video Editor — DTC & AI
description:
Salary: $2,000/month + uncapped performance bonuses

Bonus: $100 for every winning ad creative

Milestone Bonus: Additional $500 when your ad reaches $50,000 in ad spend

Location: Remote

Employment: Full-Time



We’re Looking for the Best Video Editors in the Game



This is not a standard video editing position.



We are looking for elite performance video editors who understand how to create ads that don’t just look good — they convert, scale, and generate revenue.



We intentionally pay significantly above the average for this type of role because we want to work with editors who are among the best at what they do.



If you have mastered direct-response DTC video editing, understand consumer psychology, and know how to combine traditional editing with the latest AI video generation and editing tools, we want to hear from you.



Your goal is simple:



Create ads that look real, feel premium, and perform at scale.



About Us



We are a premium 8-figure men’s fashion brand selling globally through direct-to-consumer e-commerce.



We are not a typical dropshipping company.



We invest heavily in:



Premium products

Strong branding

High-quality creative production

Performance marketing

Creative testing at scale



Our paid advertising team produces a high volume of creatives across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms, and creative performance is one of the biggest drivers of our growth.



We are now looking for exceptional editors who can help us produce the next generation of winning ads.



What You’ll Do



You will be responsible for turning concepts, raw footage, UGC, AI-generated footage, product assets, and existing content into high-converting paid social advertisements.



Your responsibilities include:



Edit direct-response video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels.

Create UGC, founder-led, advertorial, product-focused, lifestyle, testimonial, and story-driven advertisements.

Build strong hooks designed to stop the scroll immediately.

Turn marketing angles, personas, pain points, and USPs into compelling video ads.

Produce multiple variations of winning concepts for structured creative testing.

Use AI to create highly realistic scenes, actors, voiceovers, environments, product demonstrations, and supporting footage.

Combine AI-generated content with real footage in a way that feels natural and believable.

Add captions, motion graphics, sound design, pacing, visual effects, and pattern interrupts where they improve performance.

Maintain a premium fashion aesthetic while still optimizing heavily for conversion.

Collaborate closely with our creative strategists, media buyers, and marketing team.

Analyze winning ads and understand why they worked, then create iterations around those learnings.

Stay ahead of new creative formats, editing styles, AI tools, and paid social trends.

What You Need to Master

Direct-Response DTC Editing



You should already understand concepts such as:



Hooks

Retention

Scroll stopping

Consumer psychology

Pain points

Desires

Personas

USPs

Objection handling

Social proof

Pattern interrupts

Offer presentation

Calls to action

Creative fatigue

Iteration of winning concepts



We do not want someone who only knows how to make aesthetically pleasing videos.



You need to understand that every editing decision can affect CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, and ultimately revenue.



AI Video Editing & Generation



Strong AI experience is required.



You should be comfortable working with tools such as:



Higgsfield

ElevenLabs

Nano Banana

Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent professional editing software

AI video generation platforms

AI image generation platforms

AI voice and lip-sync tools

AI enhancement and post-production tools



We care less about the exact software you use and more about the quality of the final result.



AI-generated content should not immediately look AI-generated.



It needs to feel realistic, natural, premium, and believable enough to run as a serious paid advertisement.



Requirements



Must Have:



Proven experience editing paid advertisements for DTC e-commerce brands.

Strong understanding of direct-response marketing.

A portfolio containing ads that were actually used for paid acquisition.

Experience creating performance creatives rather than only organic social content.

Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and visual hierarchy.

Ability to create premium fashion creatives.

Strong understanding of different customer personas and how messaging should change between them.

Ability to turn USPs and marketing angles into compelling visual stories.

Experience working with AI-generated video or imagery.

Excellent English communication skills.

Ability to work full-time and consistently hit deadlines.

Extremely high attention to detail.

The Standard We Expect



You should understand the difference between an ad for a premium global fashion brand and a generic e-commerce or dropshipping creative.



A great ad for us needs to achieve both:



Performance + Brand.



Your work should:



Look premium.

Feel authentic.

Look realistic.

Capture attention immediately.

Communicate the USP clearly.

Speak directly to a specific customer persona.

Maintain established brand guidelines.

Create desire for the product.

Drive measurable conversions.

Be good enough to scale significant advertising spend behind it.



We want editors who take pride in seeing their creatives become winners.



Compensation



We believe exceptional creative talent should be rewarded based on the value it creates.



Base Salary: $2,000/month



Performance Bonuses:



$100 for every winning ad creative

Additional $500 when one of your ads reaches $50,000 in ad spend



There is significant upside for editors who consistently produce winning creatives.



If you are genuinely one of the best editors in the industry, we want your compensation to reflect that.



Why Join Us?

Work for an established 8-figure international fashion brand.

See your creatives tested with serious advertising budgets.

Get rewarded directly when your ads perform.

Work with experienced media buyers, marketers, and creative strategists.

Use cutting-edge AI tools as part of the creative process.

Produce a large volume of work and improve extremely quickly through real performance data.

Long-term career and compensation growth for exceptional performers.

To Apply



Please send:



Your portfolio

Your 3–5 best paid ads

The DTC brands you have previously worked with

Any performance data you can share from creatives you edited

Your favorite AI video/image tools and how you use them

One example of an AI-generated or AI-enhanced ad you are proud of



Important: We are looking for experienced performance editors. A portfolio containing only cinematic videos, organic social content, or traditional brand videos will not be enough.



If you know how to create ads that look world-class and generate revenue, we want to hear from you.
